label.en: Baked salmon, rice and broccoli — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤鮭魚、白飯與青花菜（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses dry-heat-cooked farmed Atlantic salmon and boiled drained broccoli. All listed oil and salt stay on the plate; no sauce is included.
notes.zh: 使用乾熱烹調的養殖大西洋鮭魚與水煮瀝乾青花菜。表列油鹽全部留在盤中，不含醬汁。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list throughout. Cook enough of each ingredient to obtain the listed edible weights; cooked grams are not raw purchase weights.
instructions.zh: 全程採用所選份量的食材清單。先備妥足夠食材，烹煮後再取表列可食重量；清單中的熟重不是購買生食材的重量。

instructions.en: Start the plain enriched long-grain white rice first. Cook it in water according to the package or rice-cooker directions, without extra oil or salt; keep it covered until ready to portion.
instructions.zh: 先煮原味營養強化長粒白米。依包裝或電鍋指示加水煮熟，不另外加油鹽；煮好後加蓋，待分裝時再秤量。

instructions.en: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Put thawed, plain farmed Atlantic salmon in a foil-lined baking tray and bake until the center reaches 145°F (63°C). About 10–15 minutes is a guide; thickness and size can change the time. Add the listed oil and salt after cooking.
instructions.zh: 烤箱預熱至 450°F（約 230°C）。將已解凍、未調味的養殖大西洋鮭魚放入鋪鋁箔的烤盤，烤至中心達 145°F（63°C）；約 10–15 分鐘僅供參考，厚度與大小會影響時間。表列油鹽留待烤好後加入。

instructions.en: Cut the broccoli into similar-sized florets and smaller stem pieces. Add to boiling unsalted water and cook until tender, using about 3–5 minutes as a guide; drain well. Do not roast or fry it for this recipe.
instructions.zh: 將青花菜切成大小相近的小朵，菜梗再切小一些。放入無鹽滾水煮至軟熟，約 3–5 分鐘僅供參考；充分瀝乾。此配方使用水煮青花菜。

instructions.en: Remove salmon bones and any skin that will not be eaten. Weigh the cooked salmon flesh, cooked rice and drained broccoli separately to the selected amounts.
instructions.zh: 去除鮭魚骨與不食用的魚皮，將熟魚肉、熟白飯及瀝乾青花菜分別秤至所選份量。

instructions.en: Arrange the weighed ingredients in the serving bowl. Add all the olive oil and salt shown for the selected portion and mix or drizzle them over the food; no additional cooking oil or dressing is included.
instructions.zh: 將秤好的食材盛入餐碗，加入所選份量清單中的全部橄欖油與鹽，拌勻或淋在食物上；不另加烹調用油或醬汁。

timingNote.en: The assembly estimate starts after the ingredients have been cooked and prepared; it excludes cooking, soaking and chilling. Start the rice before the fish and cook the broccoli while the fish bakes. Oven preheating and cooking from raw ingredients are additional to assembly. The preparation methods are adapted from the linked sources; ingredient times are guides, and the full meal has no kitchen-tested start-to-finish time.
timingNote.zh: 組合時間從食材已煮熟、處理完成後開始計算，不含烹調、浸泡與冷卻。先煮飯，再烤魚；烤魚時可水煮青花菜。烤箱預熱與生食材烹調都另需時間。做法參考下列來源調整，各項烹調時間僅供參考，尚無經實測的完整餐點總時間。

label.en: Edamame, broccoli and rice — standard recipe
label.zh: 毛豆、青花菜與白飯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses cooked shelled edamame, boiled drained broccoli and cooked white rice. The retained meal ID refers to an older tofu version; this formulation contains no tofu. All listed olive oil and salt are added after cooking and included in the estimate. No sauce, marinade or sweetener is included.
notes.zh: 使用熟毛豆仁、水煮瀝乾青花菜與熟白飯。保留的餐點代碼來自舊豆腐版本；目前配方不含豆腐。表列橄欖油與鹽在烹調後全部加入並計入估算，不含醬汁、醃料或甜味料。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list throughout. Cook enough of each ingredient to obtain the listed edible weights; cooked grams are not raw purchase weights.
instructions.zh: 全程採用所選份量的食材清單。先備妥足夠食材，烹煮後再取表列可食重量；清單中的熟重不是購買生食材的重量。

instructions.en: Start the plain enriched long-grain white rice first. Cook it in water according to the package or rice-cooker directions, without extra oil or salt; keep it covered until ready to portion.
instructions.zh: 先煮原味營養強化長粒白米。依包裝或電鍋指示加水煮熟，不另外加油鹽；煮好後加蓋，待分裝時再秤量。

instructions.en: Cook plain frozen edamame according to its package directions, without extra salt. Drain and remove any pods; only the cooked beans go into the weighed portion.
instructions.zh: 原味冷凍毛豆依包裝指示煮熟，不額外加鹽。瀝乾並去除豆莢；只把煮熟豆仁計入秤重份量。

instructions.en: Cut the broccoli into similar-sized florets and smaller stem pieces. Add to boiling unsalted water and cook until tender, using about 3–5 minutes as a guide; drain well. Do not roast or fry it for this recipe.
instructions.zh: 將青花菜切成大小相近的小朵，菜梗再切小一些。放入無鹽滾水煮至軟熟，約 3–5 分鐘僅供參考；充分瀝乾。此配方使用水煮青花菜。

instructions.en: Weigh the cooked shelled edamame, cooked rice and drained broccoli separately. The bean ingredient is edamame, not tofu; use the edible beans without their pods.
instructions.zh: 將熟毛豆仁、熟白飯及瀝乾青花菜分別秤至所選份量。此配方使用毛豆，秤重不含豆莢。

instructions.en: Arrange the weighed ingredients in the serving bowl. Add all the olive oil and salt shown for the selected portion and mix or drizzle them over the food; no additional cooking oil or dressing is included.
instructions.zh: 將秤好的食材盛入餐碗，加入所選份量清單中的全部橄欖油與鹽，拌勻或淋在食物上；不另加烹調用油或醬汁。

timingNote.en: The assembly estimate starts after the ingredients have been cooked and prepared; it excludes cooking, soaking and chilling. Allow time to cook the rice, edamame and broccoli before assembly. This warm version can be served as soon as the ingredients are ready. The preparation methods are adapted from the linked sources; ingredient times are guides, and the full meal has no kitchen-tested start-to-finish time.
timingNote.zh: 組合時間從食材已煮熟、處理完成後開始計算，不含烹調、浸泡與冷卻。組合前先完成白飯、毛豆與青花菜的烹調；食材備妥後即可溫熱食用。做法參考下列來源調整，各項烹調時間僅供參考，尚無經實測的完整餐點總時間。

label.en: Roasted chicken breast, broccoli and rice — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤雞胸、青花菜與白飯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses roasted skinless breast, not grilled or fried chicken. Weigh only the cooked edible meat. No marinade, skin, bone or sauce is included.
notes.zh: 限定去皮烤雞胸，不以此估算煎炸或其他雞肉。只秤煮熟後可食肉重，不含醃料、雞皮、骨頭或醬汁。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list throughout. Cook enough of each ingredient to obtain the listed edible weights; cooked grams are not raw purchase weights.
instructions.zh: 全程採用所選份量的食材清單。先備妥足夠食材，烹煮後再取表列可食重量；清單中的熟重不是購買生食材的重量。

instructions.en: Start the plain enriched long-grain white rice first. Cook it in water according to the package or rice-cooker directions, without extra oil or salt; keep it covered until ready to portion.
instructions.zh: 先煮原味營養強化長粒白米。依包裝或電鍋指示加水煮熟，不另外加油鹽；煮好後加蓋，待分裝時再秤量。

instructions.en: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Place thawed, plain boneless skinless chicken breast in a baking-paper-lined dish. Roast until a food thermometer in the thickest part reads 165°F (74°C); piece size affects cooking time. Reserve the listed oil and salt for serving.
instructions.zh: 烤箱預熱至 350°F（約 175°C）。將已解凍、未調味的去骨去皮雞胸放入鋪烘焙紙的烤盤，烤至最厚處食物溫度計讀值達 165°F（74°C）；肉塊大小會影響時間。表列油鹽留待盛盤時加入。

instructions.en: Cut the broccoli into similar-sized florets and smaller stem pieces. Add to boiling unsalted water and cook until tender, using about 3–5 minutes as a guide; drain well. Do not roast or fry it for this recipe.
instructions.zh: 將青花菜切成大小相近的小朵，菜梗再切小一些。放入無鹽滾水煮至軟熟，約 3–5 分鐘僅供參考；充分瀝乾。此配方使用水煮青花菜。

instructions.en: Slice the cooked breast and weigh only the edible cooked meat. Separately weigh the cooked rice and drained broccoli to match the selected ingredient list.
instructions.zh: 熟雞胸切片後只秤可食熟肉；熟白飯與瀝乾青花菜也分別秤至所選食材清單的重量。

instructions.en: Arrange the weighed ingredients in the serving bowl. Add all the olive oil and salt shown for the selected portion and mix or drizzle them over the food; no additional cooking oil or dressing is included.
instructions.zh: 將秤好的食材盛入餐碗，加入所選份量清單中的全部橄欖油與鹽，拌勻或淋在食物上；不另加烹調用油或醬汁。

timingNote.en: The assembly estimate starts after the ingredients have been cooked and prepared; it excludes cooking, soaking and chilling. Start the rice first, roast the chicken and cook the broccoli while the other ingredients cook. Oven preheating and raw chicken cooking are outside the assembly estimate. The preparation methods are adapted from the linked sources; ingredient times are guides, and the full meal has no kitchen-tested start-to-finish time.
timingNote.zh: 組合時間從食材已煮熟、處理完成後開始計算，不含烹調、浸泡與冷卻。先煮飯，再烤雞胸，並利用其他食材烹調時水煮青花菜。烤箱預熱與生雞胸烹調都不在組合時間估計內。做法參考下列來源調整，各項烹調時間僅供參考，尚無經實測的完整餐點總時間。

label.en: Hard-boiled egg and fresh tomato over rice — standard recipe
label.zh: 水煮蛋與鮮番茄蓋飯（標準配方）

notes.en: This is a sliced hard-boiled egg and raw tomato version, not tomato scrambled eggs. Egg weight excludes shell; tomato weight is raw edible flesh. No sugar or sauce is added.
notes.zh: 這是切片水煮蛋搭配生番茄的版本，不是番茄炒蛋。蛋重不含殼，番茄以生的可食部分秤量，不加糖或醬汁。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list throughout. Cook enough of each ingredient to obtain the listed edible weights; cooked grams are not raw purchase weights.
instructions.zh: 全程採用所選份量的食材清單。先備妥足夠食材，烹煮後再取表列可食重量；清單中的熟重不是購買生食材的重量。

instructions.en: Start the plain enriched long-grain white rice first. Cook it in water according to the package or rice-cooker directions, without extra oil or salt; keep it covered until ready to portion.
instructions.zh: 先煮原味營養強化長粒白米。依包裝或電鍋指示加水煮熟，不另外加油鹽；煮好後加蓋，待分裝時再秤量。

instructions.en: Put eggs in one layer in a saucepan and cover with cold water by about 1 inch (2.5 cm). Bring just to a boil, remove from the heat and cover. For large eggs, stand about 12 minutes; the white and yolk must be firm. Cool in cold water, peel and slice.
instructions.zh: 雞蛋在鍋內平放一層，加冷水至高出蛋約 1 英吋（2.5 公分）。加熱至剛沸騰就離火、加蓋；大顆蛋約靜置 12 分鐘，蛋白與蛋黃都須凝固。以冷水降溫後剝殼切片。

instructions.en: Rinse the tomato under running water, remove the stem and any inedible core, and slice it. Keep the tomato raw for this recipe.
instructions.zh: 番茄以流動清水洗淨，去蒂及不可食用的硬心後切片；此配方的番茄保留生食狀態。

instructions.en: Weigh the peeled hard-boiled egg, raw edible tomato and cooked rice separately to the selected amounts. Put the rice in a bowl and arrange the egg and tomato on top.
instructions.zh: 去殼水煮蛋、生番茄可食部分與熟白飯分別秤至所選重量。白飯盛碗，再排上蛋與番茄。

instructions.en: Drizzle over all the measured olive oil and sprinkle over the measured salt. Serve the egg and tomato as slices; this preparation does not scramble or fry the egg.
instructions.zh: 淋上全部計量橄欖油並撒上計量鹽，保留蛋與番茄的切片狀態食用，不將蛋炒散或油煎。

timingNote.en: The assembly estimate starts after the ingredients have been cooked and prepared; it excludes cooking, soaking and chilling. Cook the rice and hard-boil the eggs before assembly; the eggs also need enough cooling to peel. Raw tomato needs washing and slicing. The preparation methods are adapted from the linked sources; ingredient times are guides, and the full meal has no kitchen-tested start-to-finish time.
timingNote.zh: 組合時間從食材已煮熟、處理完成後開始計算，不含烹調、浸泡與冷卻。組合前先煮白飯與水煮蛋，蛋還需要降溫至可剝殼；生番茄需清洗切片。做法參考下列來源調整，各項烹調時間僅供參考，尚無經實測的完整餐點總時間。

label.en: Rice porridge with boiled egg and broccoli — standard recipe
label.zh: 白飯粥、水煮蛋與青花菜（標準配方）

notes.en: Standard-portion calculation: soften 120 g already-cooked rice with water, then top up so rice plus retained water weighs 360 g before sides. For another portion, use its listed rice and water weights. Consume all liquid. No raw-rice yield factor or restaurant-congee equivalence is claimed; no oil or sauce is added.
notes.zh: 標準份配方計算：將 120 克已煮熟白飯加水煮軟，最後補水至飯與保留湯水共 360 克，再配旁邊的蛋菜。其他份量請依各自清單的飯與水重量調整。湯水全部食用；不套用生米熟化倍率，也不代表餐廳粥品，不加油或醬汁。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list throughout. Cook enough of each ingredient to obtain the listed edible weights; cooked grams are not raw purchase weights.
instructions.zh: 全程採用所選份量的食材清單。先備妥足夠食材，烹煮後再取表列可食重量；清單中的熟重不是購買生食材的重量。

instructions.en: If starting with dry rice, cook plain enriched long-grain white rice in water according to its package directions first. Weigh the cooked rice amount in the selected-portion list; do not start with that weight of dry rice.
instructions.zh: 若從生米開始，先依包裝指示以清水煮熟營養強化長粒白米，再秤取所選份量清單中的熟白飯重量；不要以相同克數的生米直接下鍋。

instructions.en: Put eggs in one layer in a saucepan and cover with cold water by about 1 inch (2.5 cm). Bring just to a boil, remove from the heat and cover. For large eggs, stand about 12 minutes; the white and yolk must be firm. Cool in cold water, peel and slice.
instructions.zh: 雞蛋在鍋內平放一層，加冷水至高出蛋約 1 英吋（2.5 公分）。加熱至剛沸騰就離火、加蓋；大顆蛋約靜置 12 分鐘，蛋白與蛋黃都須凝固。以冷水降溫後剝殼切片。

instructions.en: Cut the broccoli into similar-sized florets and smaller stem pieces. Add to boiling unsalted water and cook until tender, using about 3–5 minutes as a guide; drain well. Do not roast or fry it for this recipe.
instructions.zh: 將青花菜切成大小相近的小朵，菜梗再切小一些。放入無鹽滾水煮至軟熟，約 3–5 分鐘僅供參考；充分瀝乾。此配方使用水煮青花菜。

instructions.en: Put the weighed cooked rice and the listed drinking water in a saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring and breaking up clumps, until the rice is soft enough for the texture you want. Add a little water if needed to prevent sticking.
instructions.zh: 將秤好的熟白飯與表列飲用水放入小鍋，小火煮至微滾，攪拌並撥散飯粒，煮到喜歡的軟度；必要時補少量水避免黏鍋。

instructions.en: Before adding the egg, broccoli or salt, adjust the cooked rice-and-water mixture to a final weight equal to the selected cooked-rice grams plus the selected water grams. Replace evaporated water, or simmer off extra water. At the standard portion this is 120 g rice + 240 g retained water = 360 g; other portions use their own list.
instructions.zh: 加入蛋、青花菜與鹽之前，將飯粥總重調整為所選「熟白飯克數＋保留水克數」；蒸發的水需補回，多餘的水則繼續煮掉。標準份量為 120 克熟飯＋240 克保留水＝360 克；其他份量依各自清單計算。

instructions.en: Weigh the peeled cooked egg and drained broccoli to the selected amounts. Add the measured salt to the porridge, serve the egg and broccoli alongside or on top, and include all the listed liquid. No oil is listed for this recipe.
instructions.zh: 去殼熟蛋與瀝乾青花菜秤至所選重量。表列鹽拌入粥內，蛋菜可放旁邊或粥面；保留全部表列湯水。此配方不加油。

timingNote.en: The assembly estimate starts after the ingredients have been cooked and prepared; it excludes cooking, soaking and chilling. This porridge starts with already-cooked rice. Cooking rice from dry, hard-boiling the eggs and cooking the broccoli add preparation time before the final porridge assembly. The preparation methods are adapted from the linked sources; ingredient times are guides, and the full meal has no kitchen-tested start-to-finish time.
timingNote.zh: 組合時間從食材已煮熟、處理完成後開始計算，不含烹調、浸泡與冷卻。這道飯粥從已煮熟白飯開始；若從生米煮飯，再煮蛋與青花菜，這些都是最後煮粥組合前的額外時間。做法參考下列來源調整，各項烹調時間僅供參考，尚無經實測的完整餐點總時間。

The retained meal ID refers to an older tofu version; this formulation contains no tofu or raw cucumber. All listed olive oil and salt are added after preparation. No sauce, marinade or sweetener is included.
notes.zh: 使用煮熟毛豆仁、去殼水煮蛋及水煮瀝乾青花菜，冷藏降溫後食用。保留的餐點代碼來自舊豆腐版本；目前配方不含豆腐或生小黃瓜。表列橄欖油與鹽在處理後全部加入，不含醬汁、醃料或甜味料。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list throughout. Cook enough of each ingredient to obtain the listed edible weights; cooked grams are not raw purchase weights.
instructions.zh: 全程採用所選份量的食材清單。先備妥足夠食材，烹煮後再取表列可食重量；清單中的熟重不是購買生食材的重量。

instructions.en: Put eggs in one layer in a saucepan and cover with cold water by about 1 inch (2.5 cm). Bring just to a boil, remove from the heat and cover. For large eggs, stand about 12 minutes; the white and yolk must be firm. Cool in cold water, peel and slice.
instructions.zh: 雞蛋在鍋內平放一層，加冷水至高出蛋約 1 英吋（2.5 公分）。加熱至剛沸騰就離火、加蓋；大顆蛋約靜置 12 分鐘，蛋白與蛋黃都須凝固。以冷水降溫後剝殼切片。

instructions.en: Cook plain frozen edamame according to its package directions, without extra salt. Drain and remove any pods; only the cooked beans go into the weighed portion.
instructions.zh: 原味冷凍毛豆依包裝指示煮熟，不額外加鹽。瀝乾並去除豆莢；只把煮熟豆仁計入秤重份量。

instructions.en: Cut the broccoli into similar-sized florets and smaller stem pieces. Add to boiling unsalted water and cook until tender, using about 3–5 minutes as a guide; drain well. Do not roast or fry it for this recipe.
instructions.zh: 將青花菜切成大小相近的小朵，菜梗再切小一些。放入無鹽滾水煮至軟熟，約 3–5 分鐘僅供參考；充分瀝乾。此配方使用水煮青花菜。

instructions.en: For the chilled bowl, divide the cooked edamame and broccoli into shallow containers and refrigerate promptly; do not leave them on the counter until completely cold. Refrigerate the peeled eggs too. Keep the refrigerator at 40°F (4°C) or below, and refrigerate cooked food within 2 hours, or 1 hour when the surroundings exceed 90°F (32°C).
instructions.zh: 製作冷碗時，將熟毛豆與青花菜分裝於淺容器並儘快冷藏，不要放在室溫等到完全冷卻；去殼蛋也放入冰箱。冰箱維持 40°F（4°C）以下，熟食在 2 小時內冷藏；環境超過 90°F（32°C）時縮短為 1 小時內。

instructions.en: When the ingredients are chilled, weigh the shelled edamame, peeled egg and drained broccoli to the selected amounts. Slice the egg and arrange the three ingredients in a bowl.
instructions.zh: 食材冷卻後，熟毛豆仁、去殼蛋與瀝乾青花菜分別秤至所選重量。蛋切片後與豆菜一起盛碗。

instructions.en: Arrange the weighed ingredients in the serving bowl. Add all the olive oil and salt shown for the selected portion and mix or drizzle them over the food; no additional cooking oil or dressing is included.
instructions.zh: 將秤好的食材盛入餐碗，加入所選份量清單中的全部橄欖油與鹽，拌勻或淋在食物上；不另加烹調用油或醬汁。

timingNote.en: The assembly estimate starts after the ingredients have been cooked and prepared; it excludes cooking, soaking and chilling. The assembly estimate assumes the beans, egg and broccoli are already cooked and chilled. Cooking and refrigerator chilling take additional time; do not treat the assembly estimate as a start-to-finish cold meal time. The preparation methods are adapted from the linked sources; ingredient times are guides, and the full meal has no kitchen-tested start-to-finish time.
timingNote.zh: 組合時間從食材已煮熟、處理完成後開始計算，不含烹調、浸泡與冷卻。組合時間以毛豆、蛋與青花菜已煮熟並冷藏降溫為前提。烹調及冰箱冷卻另需時間，不能把組合時間當作從生食材做成冷碗的總時間。做法參考下列來源調整，各項烹調時間僅供參考，尚無經實測的完整餐點總時間。

label.en: Black turtle bean, broccoli and rice bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 黑菜豆青花菜飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses unsalted boiled black turtle beans (Phaseolus vulgaris), not black soybeans (Glycine max), with drained broccoli. Canned salted beans and refried beans are not included. All added oil and salt are consumed; no salsa or other sauce is included.
notes.zh: 使用無鹽水煮黑菜豆（Phaseolus vulgaris，非黑大豆 Glycine max）與瀝乾青花菜，不代表加鹽罐頭豆或炒豆泥。添加的油鹽全部食用，不含莎莎醬或其他醬汁。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list throughout. Cook enough of each ingredient to obtain the listed edible weights; cooked grams are not raw purchase weights.
instructions.zh: 全程採用所選份量的食材清單。先備妥足夠食材，烹煮後再取表列可食重量；清單中的熟重不是購買生食材的重量。

instructions.en: Use dried black turtle beans, not black soybeans. Sort and rinse them, cover with plenty of water and soak in the refrigerator for 6–8 hours or overnight; then drain and rinse. Follow the bean package if its instructions differ.
instructions.zh: 使用乾黑菜豆，非黑大豆。挑除雜質並沖洗，加足量水浸泡，放冰箱冷藏 6–8 小時或隔夜；泡好後瀝掉水並沖洗。包裝另有指示時依包裝操作。

instructions.en: Cover the soaked beans with fresh unsalted water. Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer and cook until fully tender, adding water to keep them covered. Start checking after about 1 hour; black beans commonly take about 90–120 minutes of simmering, but age and size vary. Drain before weighing.
instructions.zh: 泡好的豆子加新鮮無鹽清水蓋過豆子，煮滾後轉小火煨煮至完全軟熟，水不足時補水維持覆蓋。約 1 小時後開始確認軟度；黑菜豆常需約 90–120 分鐘，但乾豆存放時間與大小會影響結果。秤重前瀝乾。

instructions.en: Start the plain enriched long-grain white rice first. Cook it in water according to the package or rice-cooker directions, without extra oil or salt; keep it covered until ready to portion.
instructions.zh: 先煮原味營養強化長粒白米。依包裝或電鍋指示加水煮熟，不另外加油鹽；煮好後加蓋，待分裝時再秤量。

instructions.en: Cut the broccoli into similar-sized florets and smaller stem pieces. Add to boiling unsalted water and cook until tender, using about 3–5 minutes as a guide; drain well. Do not roast or fry it for this recipe.
instructions.zh: 將青花菜切成大小相近的小朵，菜梗再切小一些。放入無鹽滾水煮至軟熟，約 3–5 分鐘僅供參考；充分瀝乾。此配方使用水煮青花菜。

instructions.en: Weigh the drained cooked beans, cooked rice and drained broccoli separately to the selected amounts. Use the cooked-bean weight, not the dry or soaked weight; salted canned beans are not the same source ingredient.
instructions.zh: 煮熟瀝乾的黑菜豆、熟白飯與瀝乾青花菜分別秤至所選重量。豆子採煮熟後重量，不採乾重或泡水後重量；加鹽罐頭豆不是此處相同的來源食材。

instructions.en: Arrange the weighed ingredients in the serving bowl. Add all the olive oil and salt shown for the selected portion and mix or drizzle them over the food; no additional cooking oil or dressing is included.
instructions.zh: 將秤好的食材盛入餐碗，加入所選份量清單中的全部橄欖油與鹽，拌勻或淋在食物上；不另加烹調用油或醬汁。

timingNote.en: The assembly estimate starts after the ingredients have been cooked and prepared; it excludes cooking, soaking and chilling. Dried beans need soaking plus a long simmer before assembly; prepare a batch ahead if useful. Rice and broccoli also need cooking. A 10-minute assembly estimate does not cover cooking this meal from dried beans. The preparation methods are adapted from the linked sources; ingredient times are guides, and the full meal has no kitchen-tested start-to-finish time.
timingNote.zh: 組合時間從食材已煮熟、處理完成後開始計算，不含烹調、浸泡與冷卻。乾豆在組合前需要浸泡與長時間煨煮，可事先多煮一批備用；白飯與青花菜也需烹調。10 分鐘組合時間不包含從乾豆開始做完整餐點。做法參考下列來源調整，各項烹調時間僅供參考，尚無經實測的完整餐點總時間。

label.en: Baked salmon, sweet potato and broccoli — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤鮭魚、地瓜與青花菜（標準配方）

notes.en: A generic standardized plate, not a Costco product. Sweet potato is baked in its skin but only cooked flesh is weighed; skin is excluded. Broccoli is boiled and drained, not roasted.
notes.zh: 這是一般定量餐盤，不是 Costco 商品資料。地瓜帶皮烤熟，但只秤熟地瓜肉、不含皮；青花菜為水煮瀝乾，不以烤蔬菜資料替代。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list throughout. Cook enough of each ingredient to obtain the listed edible weights; cooked grams are not raw purchase weights.
instructions.zh: 全程採用所選份量的食材清單。先備妥足夠食材，烹煮後再取表列可食重量；清單中的熟重不是購買生食材的重量。

instructions.en: Start the sweet potato first. Heat the oven to 400°F (205°C), scrub and rinse the whole sweet potato, pierce the skin several times and place on a baking sheet. Bake until tender all the way through, using about 45–60 minutes as a guide; size can change the time.
instructions.zh: 先烤地瓜。烤箱預熱至 400°F（約 205°C），整條地瓜刷洗乾淨，在表皮刺幾個孔後放烤盤。烤至中心也軟熟，約 45–60 分鐘僅供參考，大小會影響時間。

instructions.en: When the sweet potato is cooked, set it aside until safe to handle. Increase the oven to 450°F (230°C). Bake thawed, plain farmed Atlantic salmon in a foil-lined baking tray to a center temperature of 145°F (63°C); about 10–15 minutes is a guide, depending on size and thickness.
instructions.zh: 地瓜烤好後先放旁邊，降溫至可安全操作。烤箱調至 450°F（約 230°C），將已解凍、未調味的養殖大西洋鮭魚放入鋪鋁箔的烤盤，烤至中心達 145°F（63°C）；約 10–15 分鐘僅供參考，仍依大小與厚度調整。

instructions.en: Cut the broccoli into similar-sized florets and smaller stem pieces. Add to boiling unsalted water and cook until tender, using about 3–5 minutes as a guide; drain well. Do not roast or fry it for this recipe.
instructions.zh: 將青花菜切成大小相近的小朵，菜梗再切小一些。放入無鹽滾水煮至軟熟，約 3–5 分鐘僅供參考；充分瀝乾。此配方使用水煮青花菜。

instructions.en: Remove the sweet potato skin and weigh only its baked flesh. Remove bones and any uneaten skin from the salmon, then weigh the cooked fish flesh and drained broccoli separately to the selected amounts.
instructions.zh: 剝除地瓜皮，只秤烤熟地瓜肉；鮭魚去骨與不食用的魚皮後，只秤熟魚肉。地瓜肉、魚肉及瀝乾青花菜各自採所選重量。

instructions.en: Plate the salmon, sweet potato flesh and broccoli. Add all the measured olive oil and salt after cooking. This is the generic recipe shown in the ingredient list, not a Costco prepared product.
instructions.zh: 鮭魚、地瓜肉與青花菜盛盤後，加上全部計量橄欖油與鹽。這是食材清單所列的一般定量配方，不是 Costco 熟食商品。

timingNote.en: The assembly estimate starts after the ingredients have been cooked and prepared; it excludes cooking, soaking and chilling. The whole sweet potato takes much longer than assembly. This method bakes it before the fish so each ingredient uses its stated oven method; include preheating, baking and handling time when planning. The preparation methods are adapted from the linked sources; ingredient times are guides, and the full meal has no kitchen-tested start-to-finish time.
timingNote.zh: 組合時間從食材已煮熟、處理完成後開始計算，不含烹調、浸泡與冷卻。整條地瓜的烘烤時間遠超過組合時間。此做法先烤地瓜再烤魚，分別使用各自的烤箱條件；安排時間時需計入預熱、烘烤與降溫處理。做法參考下列來源調整，各項烹調時間僅供參考，尚無經實測的完整餐點總時間。

label.en: Edamame, kale and quinoa — standard recipe
label.zh: 毛豆、羽衣甘藍與藜麥（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses cooked shelled edamame, boiled drained kale and cooked quinoa. The retained meal ID refers to an older tofu version; this formulation contains no tofu. All beans, kale and quinoa are weighed cooked; all listed olive oil and salt are added after cooking. No sauce, marinade or sweetener is included.
notes.zh: 使用熟毛豆仁、水煮瀝乾羽衣甘藍與熟藜麥。保留的餐點代碼來自舊豆腐版本；目前配方不含豆腐。毛豆、羽衣甘藍與藜麥皆採熟重；表列橄欖油與鹽於烹調後全部加入，不含醬汁、醃料或甜味料。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list throughout. Cook enough of each ingredient to obtain the listed edible weights; cooked grams are not raw purchase weights.
instructions.zh: 全程採用所選份量的食材清單。先備妥足夠食材，烹煮後再取表列可食重量；清單中的熟重不是購買生食材的重量。

instructions.en: Rinse the quinoa unless its package says it is prewashed. Cook with plain water, following the package ratio; a common guide is 1 volume quinoa to 2 volumes water. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer gently until tender and the water is absorbed, about 12–15 minutes; fluff with a fork.
instructions.zh: 藜麥若未預先洗淨，先沖洗。依包裝比例加清水烹煮；常見參考比例為 1 份藜麥配 2 份水（以體積計）。煮滾後加蓋轉小火，約 12–15 分鐘至軟熟且水分吸收，再用叉子撥鬆。

instructions.en: Cook plain frozen edamame according to its package directions, without extra salt. Drain and remove any pods; only the cooked beans go into the weighed portion.
instructions.zh: 原味冷凍毛豆依包裝指示煮熟，不額外加鹽。瀝乾並去除豆莢；只把煮熟豆仁計入秤重份量。

instructions.en: Rinse the kale, remove tough stems and chop the leaves. Add to boiling unsalted water and cook until tender, about 5–8 minutes as a guide. Drain well; the recipe uses boiled kale, not raw or fried leaves.
instructions.zh: 羽衣甘藍洗淨，去除粗硬梗後切碎。放入無鹽滾水煮至軟熟，約 5–8 分鐘僅供參考，再充分瀝乾；本配方使用水煮羽衣甘藍。

instructions.en: Weigh the cooked quinoa, cooked shelled edamame and boiled drained kale separately to the selected amounts. Loosen the quinoa with a fork and combine it with the beans and kale.
instructions.zh: 熟藜麥、熟毛豆仁及水煮瀝乾羽衣甘藍各自秤至所選重量。藜麥用叉子撥鬆後，與毛豆、羽衣甘藍一起盛碗。

instructions.en: Arrange the weighed ingredients in the serving bowl. Add all the olive oil and salt shown for the selected portion and mix or drizzle them over the food; no additional cooking oil or dressing is included.
instructions.zh: 將秤好的食材盛入餐碗，加入所選份量清單中的全部橄欖油與鹽，拌勻或淋在食物上；不另加烹調用油或醬汁。

timingNote.en: The assembly estimate starts after the ingredients have been cooked and prepared; it excludes cooking, soaking and chilling. Cook the quinoa first and prepare the edamame and kale while it simmers. Their cooking and draining are additional to the assembly estimate. The preparation methods are adapted from the linked sources; ingredient times are guides, and the full meal has no kitchen-tested start-to-finish time.
timingNote.zh: 組合時間從食材已煮熟、處理完成後開始計算，不含烹調、浸泡與冷卻。先煮藜麥，利用小火烹煮時處理毛豆與羽衣甘藍。這些烹調及瀝乾步驟都在組合時間估計之外。做法參考下列來源調整，各項烹調時間僅供參考，尚無經實測的完整餐點總時間。

label.en: Baked salmon with cucumber and rice — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤鮭魚佐小黃瓜白飯（標準配方）

notes.en: Cooked farmed Atlantic salmon with raw cucumber, peel retained. This is not raw-fish sushi or sashimi. No soy sauce, glaze, pickling liquid or sugar is included.
notes.zh: 使用熟養殖大西洋鮭魚與帶皮生小黃瓜，不是生魚壽司或生魚片。不含醬油、照燒醬、醃漬液或糖。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list throughout. Cook enough of each ingredient to obtain the listed edible weights; cooked grams are not raw purchase weights.
instructions.zh: 全程採用所選份量的食材清單。先備妥足夠食材，烹煮後再取表列可食重量；清單中的熟重不是購買生食材的重量。

instructions.en: Start the plain enriched long-grain white rice first. Cook it in water according to the package or rice-cooker directions, without extra oil or salt; keep it covered until ready to portion.
instructions.zh: 先煮原味營養強化長粒白米。依包裝或電鍋指示加水煮熟，不另外加油鹽；煮好後加蓋，待分裝時再秤量。

instructions.en: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Put thawed, plain farmed Atlantic salmon in a foil-lined baking tray and bake until the center reaches 145°F (63°C). About 10–15 minutes is a guide; thickness and size can change the time. Add the listed oil and salt after cooking.
instructions.zh: 烤箱預熱至 450°F（約 230°C）。將已解凍、未調味的養殖大西洋鮭魚放入鋪鋁箔的烤盤，烤至中心達 145°F（63°C）；約 10–15 分鐘僅供參考，厚度與大小會影響時間。表列油鹽留待烤好後加入。

instructions.en: Wash the cucumber under running water, trim the ends and slice it with the peel retained. Keep it raw and unpickled for this recipe.
instructions.zh: 小黃瓜以流動清水洗淨，去除兩端後連皮切片。此配方使用未醃漬的生小黃瓜。

instructions.en: Remove bones and any uneaten skin from the salmon. Weigh the cooked fish flesh, cooked rice and raw edible cucumber separately to the selected amounts, then arrange on a plate or in a bowl.
instructions.zh: 鮭魚去骨與不食用的魚皮，熟魚肉、熟白飯及生小黃瓜可食部分各自秤至所選重量，再一起盛盤或盛碗。

instructions.en: Arrange the weighed ingredients in the serving bowl. Add all the olive oil and salt shown for the selected portion and mix or drizzle them over the food; no additional cooking oil or dressing is included.
instructions.zh: 將秤好的食材盛入餐碗，加入所選份量清單中的全部橄欖油與鹽，拌勻或淋在食物上；不另加烹調用油或醬汁。

timingNote.en: The assembly estimate starts after the ingredients have been cooked and prepared; it excludes cooking, soaking and chilling. Cook the rice and salmon before assembly; slice the cucumber while they cook. Oven preheating and cooking the fish and rice are additional to assembly. The preparation methods are adapted from the linked sources; ingredient times are guides, and the full meal has no kitchen-tested start-to-finish time.
timingNote.zh: 組合時間從食材已煮熟、處理完成後開始計算，不含烹調、浸泡與冷卻。先煮白飯並烤鮭魚，利用烹調時切小黃瓜。烤箱預熱及魚飯的烹調都另需時間。做法參考下列來源調整，各項烹調時間僅供參考，尚無經實測的完整餐點總時間。

label.en: Moist-heat shrimp, quinoa and broccoli — standard recipe
label.zh: 濕熱熟蝦仁、藜麥與青花菜（標準配方）

notes.en: Version 2 uses the complete USDA moist-heat cooked mixed-species shrimp record, which may include moisture-retention additives. Its sodium is 947 mg per 100 g; all its values replace the older shrimp record, including source-reported fiber 0 g. Weigh edible shrimp without shell. No breading, frying, added sauce or sweetener is included.
notes.zh: 第二版完整改用 USDA 濕熱煮熟混合品種蝦紀錄，可能包含保水添加物。該來源每 100 克含鈉 947 毫克；所有數值均取代舊蝦紀錄，包含來源提供的纖維 0 克。只秤去殼可食熟蝦重，不含裹粉、油炸、額外醬汁或甜味料。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list throughout. Cook enough of each ingredient to obtain the listed edible weights; cooked grams are not raw purchase weights.
instructions.zh: 全程採用所選份量的食材清單。先備妥足夠食材，烹煮後再取表列可食重量；清單中的熟重不是購買生食材的重量。

instructions.en: Check the shrimp product and preparation before cooking. The displayed nutrition uses a USDA moist-heat cooked shrimp record that may include moisture-retention additives and contains 947 mg sodium per 100 g; plain fresh shrimp or another brand can differ. Cooking these steps does not make a different product match that source.
instructions.zh: 烹調前確認蝦子的產品與處理方式。畫面營養採 USDA 濕熱熟蝦來源，可能含保水添加物，每 100 克鈉為 947 毫克；一般鮮蝦或其他品牌可能不同。依下列步驟煮熟，不會讓不同產品自動變成相同來源數值。

instructions.en: Rinse the quinoa unless its package says it is prewashed. Cook with plain water, following the package ratio; a common guide is 1 volume quinoa to 2 volumes water. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer gently until tender and the water is absorbed, about 12–15 minutes; fluff with a fork.
instructions.zh: 藜麥若未預先洗淨，先沖洗。依包裝比例加清水烹煮；常見參考比例為 1 份藜麥配 2 份水（以體積計）。煮滾後加蓋轉小火，約 12–15 分鐘至軟熟且水分吸收，再用叉子撥鬆。

instructions.en: Cut the broccoli into similar-sized florets and smaller stem pieces. Add to boiling unsalted water and cook until tender, using about 3–5 minutes as a guide; drain well. Do not roast or fry it for this recipe.
instructions.zh: 將青花菜切成大小相近的小朵，菜梗再切小一些。放入無鹽滾水煮至軟熟，約 3–5 分鐘僅供參考；充分瀝乾。此配方使用水煮青花菜。

instructions.en: If using raw shrimp, thaw in the refrigerator if frozen, then remove shells and the digestive tract. Poach in simmering plain water until the flesh is pearly white, opaque and firm; shrimp size changes the time. If using already-cooked shrimp, follow its package heating instructions instead. Drain well; do not fry or bread it.
instructions.zh: 若使用生蝦，冷凍品先在冰箱解凍，再去殼與腸泥。以微滾清水煮至蝦肉呈珍珠白、不透明且結實；大小會影響時間。若為已熟蝦，改依包裝加熱指示操作。充分瀝乾，不油煎或裹粉。

instructions.en: Weigh only the drained edible cooked shrimp, without shell or tail shell. Separately weigh the cooked quinoa and boiled drained broccoli to the selected amounts.
instructions.zh: 蝦子只秤瀝乾後可食熟蝦肉，不含外殼或尾殼。熟藜麥與水煮瀝乾青花菜各自秤至所選重量。

instructions.en: Arrange the weighed ingredients in the serving bowl. Add all the olive oil and salt shown for the selected portion and mix or drizzle them over the food; no additional cooking oil or dressing is included.
instructions.zh: 將秤好的食材盛入餐碗，加入所選份量清單中的全部橄欖油與鹽，拌勻或淋在食物上；不另加烹調用油或醬汁。

timingNote.en: The assembly estimate starts after the ingredients have been cooked and prepared; it excludes cooking, soaking and chilling. The assembly estimate assumes cooked shrimp, quinoa and broccoli. Frozen shrimp also need thawing, and raw shrimp need cooking; do not include those tasks inside the displayed assembly minutes. The preparation methods are adapted from the linked sources; ingredient times are guides, and the full meal has no kitchen-tested start-to-finish time.
timingNote.zh: 組合時間從食材已煮熟、處理完成後開始計算，不含烹調、浸泡與冷卻。組合時間以蝦、藜麥與青花菜都已煮熟為前提。冷凍蝦還需解凍，生蝦則需烹煮，這些都不包含在畫面的組合分鐘數內。做法參考下列來源調整，各項烹調時間僅供參考，尚無經實測的完整餐點總時間。

label.en: Baked salmon, edamame and rice bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤鮭魚毛豆飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses cooked farmed Atlantic salmon and prepared edamame. Weigh edamame after removing pods. Rice, broccoli, oil and salt are all included; no sauce or sweetener is included.
notes.zh: 使用熟養殖大西洋鮭魚與煮熟毛豆，毛豆秤重不含豆莢。白飯、青花菜、油鹽皆已列入，不含醬汁或甜味料。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list throughout. Cook enough of each ingredient to obtain the listed edible weights; cooked grams are not raw purchase weights.
instructions.zh: 全程採用所選份量的食材清單。先備妥足夠食材，烹煮後再取表列可食重量；清單中的熟重不是購買生食材的重量。

instructions.en: Start the plain enriched long-grain white rice first. Cook it in water according to the package or rice-cooker directions, without extra oil or salt; keep it covered until ready to portion.
instructions.zh: 先煮原味營養強化長粒白米。依包裝或電鍋指示加水煮熟，不另外加油鹽；煮好後加蓋，待分裝時再秤量。

instructions.en: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Put thawed, plain farmed Atlantic salmon in a foil-lined baking tray and bake until the center reaches 145°F (63°C). About 10–15 minutes is a guide; thickness and size can change the time. Add the listed oil and salt after cooking.
instructions.zh: 烤箱預熱至 450°F（約 230°C）。將已解凍、未調味的養殖大西洋鮭魚放入鋪鋁箔的烤盤，烤至中心達 145°F（63°C）；約 10–15 分鐘僅供參考，厚度與大小會影響時間。表列油鹽留待烤好後加入。

instructions.en: Cook plain frozen edamame according to its package directions, without extra salt. Drain and remove any pods; only the cooked beans go into the weighed portion.
instructions.zh: 原味冷凍毛豆依包裝指示煮熟，不額外加鹽。瀝乾並去除豆莢；只把煮熟豆仁計入秤重份量。

instructions.en: Cut the broccoli into similar-sized florets and smaller stem pieces. Add to boiling unsalted water and cook until tender, using about 3–5 minutes as a guide; drain well. Do not roast or fry it for this recipe.
instructions.zh: 將青花菜切成大小相近的小朵，菜梗再切小一些。放入無鹽滾水煮至軟熟，約 3–5 分鐘僅供參考；充分瀝乾。此配方使用水煮青花菜。

instructions.en: Remove salmon bones and any skin that will not be eaten. Weigh the cooked salmon flesh, cooked shelled edamame, cooked rice and drained broccoli separately to the selected amounts; both salmon and edamame are part of this portion.
instructions.zh: 鮭魚去骨與不食用的魚皮。熟魚肉、熟毛豆仁、熟白飯及瀝乾青花菜分別秤至所選重量；鮭魚與毛豆都屬於這份配方的一部分。

instructions.en: Arrange the weighed ingredients in the serving bowl. Add all the olive oil and salt shown for the selected portion and mix or drizzle them over the food; no additional cooking oil or dressing is included.
instructions.zh: 將秤好的食材盛入餐碗，加入所選份量清單中的全部橄欖油與鹽，拌勻或淋在食物上；不另加烹調用油或醬汁。

timingNote.en: The assembly estimate starts after the ingredients have been cooked and prepared; it excludes cooking, soaking and chilling. Start the rice, then bake the fish and cook the edamame and broccoli. Oven preheating and preparing all four ingredients are additional to the assembly estimate. The preparation methods are adapted from the linked sources; ingredient times are guides, and the full meal has no kitchen-tested start-to-finish time.
timingNote.zh: 組合時間從食材已煮熟、處理完成後開始計算，不含烹調、浸泡與冷卻。先煮飯，再烤魚並煮毛豆與青花菜。烤箱預熱及四項食材的烹調處理都在組合時間估計之外。做法參考下列來源調整，各項烹調時間僅供參考，尚無經實測的完整餐點總時間。

label.en: Chicken, rice-noodle and spinach soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞肉米麵菠菜湯（標準配方）

notes.en: A clear soup assembled from roasted skinless chicken, cooked rice noodles and boiled drained vegetables. The 150 g of water is retained in the served soup, not discarded cooking water. No stock, bouillon, sugar-containing marinade or sauce is included. Use plain rice noodles made without egg or wheat; packaged substitutes can differ.
notes.zh: 使用去皮烤雞胸、煮熟米製麵條及水煮瀝乾蔬菜組成的清湯。150 克水是上桌湯水，不是倒掉的煮麵水。不含高湯、湯塊、含糖醃料或醬汁。限定不含蛋與小麥的原味米製麵條；其他包裝產品可能不同。

instructions.en: Cook and drain the plain rice noodles, spinach and carrots separately; weigh them in the cooked states shown. Slice the listed amount of prepared roasted skinless chicken.
instructions.zh: 分別煮熟並瀝乾原味米製麵條、菠菜與紅蘿蔔，按表列熟重秤量；將表列份量的已烤熟去皮雞胸切片。

instructions.en: Place the weighed ingredients in a bowl with the listed amount of hot drinking water. Add the measured olive oil and salt, then stir.
instructions.zh: 將秤好的食材放入碗內，加入表列份量的熱飲用水，拌入表列橄欖油與鹽。

instructions.en: Serve warm and consume the listed liquid. If reheating evaporates water, restore the listed final water amount before serving; extra stock or sauces change the estimate.
instructions.zh: 溫熱食用並喝完表列湯水；若加熱造成水分蒸發，上桌前補回表列水量。額外高湯或醬汁會改變估算。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including oil, salt, water, honey and juice where present.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數；油、鹽、水，以及配方中的蜂蜜或果汁也一併調整。

label.en: Egg-noodle soup with boiled egg and spinach — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞蛋麵湯佐水煮蛋與菠菜（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses cooked enriched wheat-and-egg noodles and a separately cooked hard-boiled egg, not a poached or scrambled egg. All vegetables are weighed boiled and drained. Water, oil and salt are included; no broth concentrate, sauce or sweetener is included.
notes.zh: 使用煮熟的營養強化小麥雞蛋麵及另外煮熟的水煮蛋，不是水波蛋或炒蛋。蔬菜皆秤水煮瀝乾後的熟重。水、油與鹽均已列入，不含濃縮高湯、醬汁或甜味料。

instructions.en: Prepare and drain the noodles, spinach and carrots. Peel the hard-boiled eggs, then weigh the listed amount of edible egg and slice it.
instructions.zh: 備妥並瀝乾麵條、菠菜與紅蘿蔔；水煮蛋去殼後秤取表列份量的可食部分並切片。

instructions.en: Combine the cooked noodles and vegetables with the listed amount of hot water, the measured oil and salt. Place the egg on top.
instructions.zh: 將熟麵與蔬菜放入表列份量的熱水，拌入表列油鹽，放上水煮蛋。

instructions.en: Serve warm with all the liquid. Restore any evaporated water to the specified final amount; do not count discarded noodle-cooking water.
instructions.zh: 溫熱食用並包含全部湯水；若水分蒸發，補回指定水量，不把已倒掉的煮麵水計入。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including oil, salt, water, honey and juice where present.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數；油、鹽、水，以及配方中的蜂蜜或果汁也一併調整。

label.en: Chilled edamame, carrot and whole-wheat pasta salad — standard recipe
label.zh: 冷毛豆紅蘿蔔全麥麵沙拉（標準配方）

notes.en: The noodle is cooked whole-wheat pasta, not soba or egg noodles. Edamame, carrots and spinach are all weighed cooked; no raw vegetable or juice is added, keeping qualifying FVNS weights on one cooked basis. No sweetened dressing or sauce is included.
notes.zh: 麵條限定煮熟全麥義大利麵，不是蕎麥麵或雞蛋麵。毛豆、紅蘿蔔與菠菜皆秤熟重；不加生蔬菜或果汁，使合格 FVNS 食材採相同熟重基準。不含甜沙拉醬或其他醬汁。

instructions.en: Cook and drain the whole-wheat pasta, shelled edamame, carrots and spinach separately, then weigh the prepared edible amounts shown.
instructions.zh: 分別煮熟並瀝乾全麥麵、去莢毛豆、紅蘿蔔與菠菜，再按表列可食熟重秤量。

instructions.en: Cool the prepared ingredients following their storage and handling instructions. Toss with the measured olive oil and salt.
instructions.zh: 依已處理食品的保存與操作指示冷卻，拌入表列橄欖油與鹽。

instructions.en: Serve chilled with all the listed dressing. This estimate excludes sesame oil, soy sauce, lemon juice and other extra dressings.
instructions.zh: 冷食並食用全部表列調味料；此估算不包含芝麻油、醬油、檸檬汁或其他額外沙拉醬。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including oil, salt, water, honey and juice where present.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數；油、鹽、水，以及配方中的蜂蜜或果汁也一併調整。

label.en: Grilled lean beef and egg-noodle soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤瘦牛肉雞蛋麵湯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses the exact source for grilled top-round beef, separable lean only, with visible fat removed; it is not braised beef or an estimate of restaurant beef broth. Add the already-cooked sliced beef to the soup. All qualifying vegetables are weighed boiled and drained; no stock concentrate, marinade or sauce is included.
notes.zh: 限定去除可見脂肪的烤牛後腿肉（top round）來源，不是燉牛肉，也不估算餐廳牛肉湯底。將已熟的切片牛肉加入湯中。合格蔬菜皆秤水煮瀝乾熟重；不含濃縮高湯、醃料或醬汁。

instructions.en: Slice the listed amount of prepared grilled lean top-round beef after removing visible fat. Prepare the egg noodles and boiled drained spinach and carrots at the listed weights.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟牛後腿肉（top round）去除可見脂肪後，秤取表列份量並切片；按表列重量備妥熟雞蛋麵、水煮瀝乾菠菜與紅蘿蔔。

instructions.en: Combine the noodles and vegetables with the listed amount of hot water, olive oil and salt. Add the sliced cooked beef.
instructions.zh: 將麵與蔬菜放入表列份量的熱水，加入橄欖油與鹽，再放上熟牛肉片。

instructions.en: Serve warm with all liquid, restoring any evaporation to the listed final water amount. Extra broth or sauces are outside this recipe.
instructions.zh: 補回蒸發的水分至指定最終水量後，溫熱食用並喝完湯水；額外高湯或醬汁不屬於此配方。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including oil, salt, water, honey and juice where present.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數；油、鹽、水，以及配方中的蜂蜜或果汁也一併調整。

label.en: Roast-turkey sandwich on whole-wheat French bread — standard recipe
label.zh: 全麥法式麵包烤火雞三明治（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses plain roasted turkey breast meat, not deli turkey. The bread is the specifically named whole-wheat French/Vienna bread record, not generic sandwich bread. The side salad contains raw romaine and cucumber with 10 g raw lemon juice; its juice sugars are counted as free sugars. No mayonnaise, cheese or other sauce is included.
notes.zh: 使用原味烤火雞胸肉，不是加工火雞冷切片。麵包限定列名的全麥法式／維也納麵包來源，不代表一般吐司。配菜為生蘿蔓與小黃瓜，加入 10 克新鮮檸檬汁，其糖計入游離糖。不含美乃滋、起司或其他醬料。

instructions.en: Slice the listed amount of the specified ready-to-eat whole-wheat bread. Thinly slice the listed amount of prepared skinless roasted turkey; follow its storage instructions before serving chilled.
instructions.zh: 切開表列份量的指定即食全麥麵包；將表列份量的已烤熟去皮火雞胸切薄片，冷食前依其保存指示處理。

instructions.en: Wash and drain the romaine and cucumber, then weigh the edible raw amounts. Put some romaine into the sandwich and serve the remaining vegetables alongside.
instructions.zh: 蘿蔓與小黃瓜洗淨瀝乾後秤可食生重；部分蘿蔓夾入三明治，其餘蔬菜放旁邊。

instructions.en: Mix the measured lemon juice, olive oil and salt. Add all of the dressing to the vegetables and serve.
instructions.zh: 將表列檸檬汁、橄欖油與鹽拌勻，全部淋在蔬菜上後食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including oil, salt, water, honey and juice where present.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數；油、鹽、水，以及配方中的蜂蜜或果汁也一併調整。

label.en: Spinach and boiled-egg sandwich on whole-wheat French bread — standard recipe
label.zh: 全麥法式麵包菠菜水煮蛋三明治（標準配方）

notes.en: This versioned standard recipe uses whole-wheat French/Vienna bread instead of the wrap in the legacy idea ID. The available tortilla records did not establish a ready-to-eat formulation with sufficient free-sugar evidence. This is a boiled-egg sandwich, not an omelet. No cheese, butter or sauce is included.
notes.zh: 此版本標準配方以全麥法式／維也納麵包取代舊餐點代碼中的捲餅；現有餅皮來源無法同時確立即食配方與足夠的游離糖依據。這是水煮蛋三明治，不是歐姆蛋。不含起司、奶油或醬汁。

instructions.en: Weigh the listed amount of ready-to-eat whole-wheat French/Vienna bread. Peel and slice the listed amount of prepared hard-boiled egg; drain and weigh the listed amount of cooked spinach.
instructions.zh: 秤取表列份量的即食全麥法式／維也納麵包；已煮熟水煮蛋去殼後秤取表列份量並切片，熟菠菜瀝乾後秤取表列份量。

instructions.en: Toss the warm spinach with the measured olive oil and salt. Layer the spinach and warm cooked egg inside the bread.
instructions.zh: 溫熱菠菜拌入表列橄欖油與鹽，和溫熱熟蛋一起夾入麵包。

instructions.en: Serve promptly while the filling is warm. The bread is weighed ready to eat; additional toasting, butter or sauces are not part of this estimate.
instructions.zh: 趁內餡溫熱時食用；麵包依即食狀態秤重，此估算不含額外烘烤、奶油或醬汁。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including oil, salt, water, honey and juice where present.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數；油、鹽、水，以及配方中的蜂蜜或果汁也一併調整。

label.en: Chicken salad sandwich on whole-wheat French bread — standard recipe
label.zh: 全麥法式麵包雞肉沙拉三明治（標準配方）

notes.en: This standard recipe substitutes specifically named whole-wheat French/Vienna bread for the legacy wrap idea because the tortilla free-sugar and prepared-state evidence was insufficient. It uses roasted skinless chicken, raw romaine and tomato. Lemon juice is weighed and its sugars count as free sugars; no mayonnaise or sweetened dressing is included.
notes.zh: 此標準配方以列名全麥法式／維也納麵包取代舊捲餅構想，原因是餅皮的游離糖與處理狀態證據不足。使用去皮烤雞胸、生蘿蔓與番茄；檸檬汁秤重並將其糖計入游離糖，不含美乃滋或甜沙拉醬。

instructions.en: Slice the listed amount of the specified bread and the listed amount of prepared roasted chicken. Use the prepared chicken according to its storage instructions for cold serving.
instructions.zh: 切開表列份量的指定麵包，將表列份量的已烤熟雞胸切片；冷食雞肉依已處理食品保存指示使用。

instructions.en: Wash and drain the romaine and tomato, then weigh them raw. Layer the chicken and some vegetables inside the bread; serve the rest alongside.
instructions.zh: 蘿蔓與番茄洗淨瀝乾後秤生重；將雞肉與部分蔬菜夾入麵包，其餘蔬菜放旁邊。

instructions.en: Mix the measured lemon juice, olive oil and salt. Use all of it on the filling and side vegetables.
instructions.zh: 將表列檸檬汁、橄欖油與鹽拌勻，全部用於內餡與旁邊蔬菜。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including oil, salt, water, honey and juice where present.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數；油、鹽、水，以及配方中的蜂蜜或果汁也一併調整。

label.en: Roasted chicken, sweet potato and carrots — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤雞胸地瓜紅蘿蔔餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: This source-matched version uses roasted skinless breast rather than the grilled chicken in the legacy idea title. Sweet potato is baked with skin, but only the cooked flesh is weighed and eaten. Carrots and spinach are boiled and drained, not roasted. No marinade, sauce or sweetener is included.
notes.zh: 此來源對應版本以去皮烤雞胸取代舊構想中的煎烤雞肉。地瓜帶皮烤熟，但只秤並食用熟地瓜肉；紅蘿蔔與菠菜為水煮瀝乾，不是烤蔬菜。不含醃料、醬汁或甜味料。

instructions.en: Remove the skin from prepared baked sweet potato and weigh the listed amount of flesh. Weigh the listed amount of roasted skinless chicken, the listed amount of boiled drained carrots and the listed amount of boiled drained spinach.
instructions.zh: 備好的帶皮烤地瓜去皮後秤取表列份量的地瓜肉；另秤表列份量的去皮烤雞胸、表列份量的水煮瀝乾紅蘿蔔與表列份量的水煮瀝乾菠菜。

instructions.en: Slice the chicken and sweet potato, arrange them on a plate, and place the vegetables alongside.
instructions.zh: 雞胸與地瓜切片後排盤，蔬菜放旁邊。

instructions.en: Add all the measured olive oil and salt and serve warm. The time shown begins with cooked ingredients.
instructions.zh: 加入全部表列橄欖油與鹽，溫熱食用；顯示時間從已煮熟食材開始計算。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including oil, salt, water, honey and juice where present.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數；油、鹽、水，以及配方中的蜂蜜或果汁也一併調整。

label.en: Baked salmon and skin-on potato with romaine salad — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤鮭魚帶皮馬鈴薯佐蘿蔓沙拉（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses dry-heat-cooked farmed Atlantic salmon and baked potato with its skin retained. Salad is specifically raw romaine and cucumber, not an unspecified bagged salad mix. Lemon juice contributes free sugars and raw FVNS; potato is not part of the FVNS numerator. This plate combines cooked components with a raw salad.
notes.zh: 使用乾熱烹調的養殖大西洋鮭魚及連皮食用的烤馬鈴薯。沙拉限定生蘿蔓與小黃瓜，不是成分未明的袋裝沙拉。檸檬汁納入游離糖與生重 FVNS；馬鈴薯不納入 FVNS 分子。此餐盤包含熟食與生沙拉。

instructions.en: Weigh the listed amount of edible baked salmon and the listed amount of baked potato including edible skin, with bones and inedible parts removed.
instructions.zh: 去除骨頭與不可食部分，秤取表列份量的可食熟鮭魚及表列份量的含可食皮的烤馬鈴薯。

instructions.en: Wash, drain and weigh the romaine and cucumber raw. Mix the measured lemon juice, olive oil and salt, then toss with the salad.
instructions.zh: 蘿蔓與小黃瓜洗淨瀝乾後秤生重，拌入表列檸檬汁、橄欖油與鹽。

instructions.en: Serve the salad alongside the salmon and potato, with all dressing included. Additional bagged-salad toppings or dressings change the estimate.
instructions.zh: 沙拉放在鮭魚與馬鈴薯旁，包含全部調味汁；額外袋裝沙拉配料或醬汁會改變估算。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including oil, salt, water, honey and juice where present.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數；油、鹽、水，以及配方中的蜂蜜或果汁也一併調整。

label.en: Lentil, carrot and spinach quinoa bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 扁豆紅蘿蔔菠菜藜麥碗（標準配方）

notes.en: This source-matched variant uses boiled drained carrots and spinach instead of the roasted vegetables in the legacy idea. Lentils, carrots and spinach all use cooked weights. The quinoa is cooked; salted canned lentils, sauces and sweeteners are not included.
notes.zh: 此來源對應版本以水煮瀝乾紅蘿蔔與菠菜取代舊構想中的烤蔬菜。扁豆、紅蘿蔔與菠菜皆採熟重，藜麥也已煮熟；不包含加鹽罐頭扁豆、醬汁或甜味料。

instructions.en: Cook the plain lentils and quinoa separately. Boil and drain the carrots and spinach; weigh all ingredients after preparation at the amounts shown.
instructions.zh: 分別煮熟原味扁豆與藜麥，紅蘿蔔和菠菜水煮瀝乾；處理完成後按表列熟重秤量。

instructions.en: Spoon the quinoa into a bowl, then add the lentils, carrots and spinach.
instructions.zh: 將藜麥盛入碗內，放上扁豆、紅蘿蔔與菠菜。

instructions.en: Mix through all the measured olive oil and salt. Serve warm without extra sauces; the assembly time excludes cooking from dry ingredients.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部表列橄欖油與鹽，溫熱食用，不另加醬汁；組合時間不含從乾料開始的烹煮時間。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including oil, salt, water, honey and juice where present.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數；油、鹽、水，以及配方中的蜂蜜或果汁也一併調整。

label.en: Chilled oats with Greek yogurt, blueberries and honey — standard recipe
label.zh: 冷燕麥希臘優格藍莓蜂蜜碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses oats cooked in water and then cooled, not raw overnight-soaked oats or granola. The 200 g oats includes the water already present in its cooked USDA source. Use plain unsweetened nonfat dairy Greek yogurt, without hydrolysed lactose, whey powder or added sugar. Exactly 5 g honey is included and its sugar counts as free sugars; the source added-sugar fields remain unknown. Blueberries are whole, not juice or puree.
notes.zh: 使用以水煮熟再冷卻的燕麥，不是生燕麥隔夜浸泡或穀麥脆片；200 克熟燕麥已包含 USDA 熟食來源中的水分。限定原味無加糖脫脂乳製希臘優格，不含水解乳糖、乳清粉或添加糖。配方含 5 克蜂蜜，其糖計入游離糖，但來源添加糖欄位仍未知。藍莓為完整果實，不是果汁或果泥。

instructions.en: Prepare plain oats with water and no salt, then weigh the listed amount of cooked oats. Cool them following safe storage and handling instructions; the five-minute estimate starts after cooling.
instructions.zh: 以水煮熟原味燕麥、不加鹽，秤取表列份量的熟燕麥；依食品保存與操作指示冷卻，五分鐘估計從冷卻完成後開始。

instructions.en: Spoon the listed amount of plain nonfat Greek yogurt over the chilled oats. Wash, drain and weigh the listed amount of whole blueberries, then add them.
instructions.zh: 冷燕麥上放表列份量的原味脫脂希臘優格；完整藍莓洗淨瀝乾後秤取表列份量，加入碗內。

instructions.en: Weigh and drizzle the listed amount of honey over the bowl. Serve chilled; extra honey, granola, milk or nut toppings are not included.
instructions.zh: 秤取並淋上表列份量的蜂蜜後冷食；額外蜂蜜、穀麥脆片、牛奶或堅果配料未列入估算。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including oil, salt, water, honey and juice where present.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數；油、鹽、水，以及配方中的蜂蜜或果汁也一併調整。

label.en: Chicken quinoa salad with lemon dressing — standard recipe
label.zh: 檸檬雞肉藜麥沙拉碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses cooked roasted skinless chicken and cooked quinoa, served cooled with raw romaine, tomato and cucumber. All qualifying FVNS ingredients, including raw lemon juice, use raw weights; chicken and quinoa do not contribute to that numerator. Lemon-juice sugars count as free sugars. No bottled dressing, marinade or extra sweetener is included.
notes.zh: 使用已烤熟去皮雞胸與熟藜麥，冷卻後搭配生蘿蔓、番茄與小黃瓜。含新鮮檸檬汁在內的合格 FVNS 食材皆採生重，雞肉與藜麥不納入其分子。檸檬汁中的糖計入游離糖，不含瓶裝沙拉醬、醃料或額外甜味料。

instructions.en: Weigh the prepared roasted chicken and cooked quinoa; cool them according to their storage instructions. Slice the chicken into bite-size pieces.
instructions.zh: 秤好已烤熟雞胸與熟藜麥，依食品保存指示冷卻；雞肉切成適口大小。

instructions.en: Wash, drain, chop and weigh the romaine, tomato and cucumber at the listed raw edible amounts. Combine with the chicken and quinoa.
instructions.zh: 蘿蔓、番茄與小黃瓜洗淨瀝乾切好，按表列可食生重秤量，和雞肉、藜麥混合。

instructions.en: Mix the measured lemon juice, olive oil and salt. Toss all of the dressing through the salad and serve chilled.
instructions.zh: 將表列檸檬汁、橄欖油與鹽拌勻，全部拌入沙拉後冷食。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including oil, salt, water, honey and juice where present.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數；油、鹽、水，以及配方中的蜂蜜或果汁也一併調整。

label.en: Baked Atlantic cod, rice and bok choy — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤大西洋鱈魚白飯青江菜（標準配方）

notes.en: This defined version uses dry-heat-cooked Atlantic cod, rather than the steamed fish in the legacy idea. Weigh the cooked edible fish without skin or bones. Bok choy is boiled and drained without salt before the listed seasoning is added. No breading, marinade or sauce is included.
notes.zh: 此定量版本使用乾熱烹調的大西洋鱈魚，取代舊構想中的蒸魚。魚肉去皮去骨後秤可食熟重。青江菜先無鹽水煮瀝乾，再加入表列調味料，不含裹粉、醃料或醬汁。

instructions.en: Prepare the baked Atlantic cod, cooked white rice and boiled drained bok choy. Remove bones and inedible fish parts before weighing the selected amounts.
instructions.zh: 備妥烤大西洋鱈魚、熟白飯與水煮瀝乾青江菜；魚肉去骨與不可食部分後，按所選份量秤重。

instructions.en: Place the rice and fish on a plate. Cut the cooked bok choy into manageable pieces and add it alongside.
instructions.zh: 白飯與熟魚盛盤，熟青江菜切成適口大小後放在旁邊。

instructions.en: Add all of the measured olive oil and salt, then serve warm. The assembly estimate starts with the cooked ingredients ready.
instructions.zh: 加入全部表列橄欖油與鹽後溫熱食用；組合時間從熟食材備妥後開始。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and other seasonings.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與其他調味料也一併調整。

label.en: Baked cod with mushrooms and napa cabbage — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤鱈魚蘑菇大白菜餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: This source-matched plate uses baked Atlantic cod instead of steamed cod. White mushrooms and napa cabbage are boiled and drained, then weighed cooked. It contains no rice, noodles, bread or potato; the portion is an authored recipe option rather than an energy target. No stock or sauce is included.
notes.zh: 此來源對應餐盤以烤大西洋鱈魚取代蒸鱈魚，白蘑菇與大白菜皆水煮瀝乾後秤熟重。不含白飯、麵、麵包或馬鈴薯；份量是編製的配方選項，不是熱量目標。不含高湯或醬汁。

instructions.en: Prepare the cod by dry heat without breading, and prepare the mushrooms and napa cabbage by boiling and draining. Weigh the edible cooked amounts shown.
instructions.zh: 鱈魚以乾熱方式烹調、不裹粉；蘑菇與大白菜水煮瀝乾後，按表列可食熟重秤量。

instructions.en: Arrange the fish over the cabbage and place the mushrooms alongside. Keep the separately weighed cooked ingredients on the plate.
instructions.zh: 白菜鋪底並放上熟魚，蘑菇放旁邊；分別秤好的熟食材全部保留在盤中。

instructions.en: Drizzle with the measured olive oil, add the measured salt and serve warm. Discarded vegetable-cooking water is not included.
instructions.zh: 淋上表列橄欖油、加入鹽後溫熱食用；已倒掉的煮菜水不包含在估算中。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and other seasonings.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與其他調味料也一併調整。

label.en: Lean minced pork, cabbage and rice — standard recipe
label.zh: 瘦豬絞肉高麗菜飯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses cooked crumbles from the source 96% lean / 4% fat ground-pork formulation. That percentage describes the starting mince; its cooked source contains 7.15 g total fat/100 g. This plain recipe is not a calculation for Taiwanese braised-pork sauce. Cabbage and onion are boiled and drained; soy sauce, sugar and braising liquid are not included.
notes.zh: 使用來源為 96% 瘦肉／4% 脂肪豬絞肉的熟碎粒；該比例描述原絞肉配方，熟肉來源每 100 克含總脂肪 7.15 克。這是原味配方，不用來估算臺式滷肉醬汁。高麗菜與洋蔥水煮瀝乾，不含醬油、糖或滷汁。

instructions.en: Cook the specified lean ground pork into crumbles without added sauce. Prepare rice and boil and drain the cabbage and onion; weigh all of them in the cooked states shown.
instructions.zh: 指定瘦豬絞肉不加醬料煮成碎粒；備妥白飯，將高麗菜與洋蔥水煮瀝乾，全部按表列熟重秤量。

instructions.en: Spoon the cooked pork and onion over the rice. Place the cabbage beside it.
instructions.zh: 熟豬絞肉與洋蔥放在白飯上，高麗菜放旁邊。

instructions.en: Mix in the measured olive oil and salt and serve warm. Additions such as soy sauce or sweet braising liquid change the estimate.
instructions.zh: 拌入表列橄欖油與鹽後溫熱食用；額外醬油或含糖滷汁會改變估算。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and other seasonings.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與其他調味料也一併調整。

label.en: Chicken and chickpea plate with zucchini and red pepper — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞肉鷹嘴豆櫛瓜紅甜椒餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: A defined cooked plate using roasted skinless chicken, unsalted boiled chickpeas and boiled drained zucchini and red pepper. The chickpeas are whole, not hummus or falafel. All qualifying FVNS ingredients use cooked weights. No pita, lemon juice, tahini or dressing is included.
notes.zh: 此定量熟食餐盤使用去皮烤雞胸、無鹽水煮鷹嘴豆、水煮瀝乾櫛瓜與紅甜椒。鷹嘴豆保持完整，不是鷹嘴豆泥或炸豆丸；合格 FVNS 食材皆採熟重。不含口袋餅、檸檬汁、芝麻醬或沙拉醬。

instructions.en: Weigh prepared roasted chicken and plain boiled chickpeas. Boil and drain the skin-on zucchini and red sweet pepper, then weigh the cooked amounts shown.
instructions.zh: 秤取已烤熟雞肉與原味水煮鷹嘴豆；帶皮櫛瓜和紅甜椒水煮瀝乾後按表列熟重秤量。

instructions.en: Cut the chicken into pieces and combine it with the chickpeas and vegetables on a plate.
instructions.zh: 雞肉切成適口大小，與鷹嘴豆、蔬菜一起盛盤。

instructions.en: Toss with all the measured olive oil and salt, and serve warm without extra sauces.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部表列橄欖油與鹽後溫熱食用，不另加醬汁。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and other seasonings.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與其他調味料也一併調整。

label.en: Black and white bean rice bowl with red pepper — standard recipe
label.zh: 黑菜豆與白菜豆紅甜椒飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses unsalted boiled black turtle beans and white common beans, not black soybeans or soybean products. Both beans and the red pepper and onion are weighed cooked. This rice-bowl version includes no tortilla, cheese, salsa, avocado or prepared burrito sauce.
notes.zh: 使用無鹽水煮黑菜豆與白菜豆，不是黑大豆或黃豆製品。兩種豆、紅甜椒與洋蔥均採熟重；此飯碗版本不含餅皮、起司、莎莎醬、酪梨或調製捲餅醬。

instructions.en: Prepare and drain the plain black turtle beans and white beans. Prepare the rice, and boil and drain the red pepper and onion before weighing each cooked component.
instructions.zh: 原味黑菜豆與白菜豆煮熟瀝乾，備妥白飯；紅甜椒與洋蔥水煮瀝乾後，分別秤取各項熟食份量。

instructions.en: Place the rice in a bowl and top with both beans, red pepper and onion.
instructions.zh: 白飯盛碗，放上兩種豆、紅甜椒與洋蔥。

instructions.en: Fold in all the measured olive oil and salt. Serve warm; salted canned beans or salsa would require different ingredient values.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部表列橄欖油與鹽，溫熱食用；若改用加鹽罐頭豆或莎莎醬，需另外的食材數值。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and other seasonings.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與其他調味料也一併調整。

label.en: Chicken, red pepper and onion rice bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞肉紅甜椒洋蔥飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: The legacy idea is a fajita bowl; this explicit version uses roasted chicken and boiled drained red pepper and onion, not seared restaurant fajita vegetables. All oil and salt are listed. No spice blend, tortilla, sour cream, salsa or marinade is included.
notes.zh: 舊構想為法士達碗；此明示版本使用烤雞肉與水煮瀝乾紅甜椒、洋蔥，不是餐廳煎炒法士達蔬菜。油鹽全部列出，不含綜合香料、餅皮、酸奶、莎莎醬或醃料。

instructions.en: Slice the prepared roasted chicken. Weigh the cooked rice and the separately boiled and drained red pepper and onion at the selected amounts.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟雞肉切片；白飯與分別水煮瀝乾的紅甜椒、洋蔥，按所選份量秤取熟重。

instructions.en: Add the chicken and vegetables over the rice. Toss the vegetables with the listed olive oil.
instructions.zh: 雞肉與蔬菜放在白飯上，蔬菜拌入表列橄欖油。

instructions.en: Add the measured salt and serve warm, keeping all the listed oil in the meal. Extra seasoning packets or sauces are outside this recipe.
instructions.zh: 加入表列鹽後溫熱食用，全部表列油留在餐中；額外調味包或醬汁不屬於此配方。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and other seasonings.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與其他調味料也一併調整。

label.en: Chicken and zucchini pasta with cooked tomato pieces — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞肉櫛瓜熟番茄全麥麵（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses cooked whole-wheat pasta, boiled drained zucchini and recognizable cooked tomato pieces instead of pureed tomato sauce. No puree, paste, concentrated sauce or added sugar is included. Tomato must remain in pieces for this plain intact-food free-sugar derivation; all qualifying vegetables use cooked weights.
notes.zh: 使用熟全麥義大利麵、水煮瀝乾櫛瓜及可辨識的熟番茄塊，取代泥狀番茄醬。不含果泥、濃縮番茄糊、濃縮醬汁或添加糖；番茄須保留塊狀，才符合此原味完整食物的游離糖判讀，合格蔬菜均採熟重。

instructions.en: Prepare and drain the whole-wheat pasta and skin-on zucchini. Prepare plain cooked tomato in pieces and roasted skinless chicken, then weigh the cooked edible amounts shown.
instructions.zh: 全麥麵與帶皮櫛瓜煮熟瀝乾，備妥原味熟番茄塊與去皮烤雞胸，再按表列可食熟重秤量。

instructions.en: Combine the pasta, sliced chicken, zucchini and tomato pieces in a bowl. Keep the tomato as pieces rather than blending it into sauce.
instructions.zh: 麵、切片雞肉、櫛瓜與番茄塊放入碗中混合，番茄維持塊狀，不攪打成醬。

instructions.en: Toss with the measured olive oil and salt and serve warm. Parmesan, bottled pasta sauce and unmeasured cooking oil are not included.
instructions.zh: 拌入表列橄欖油與鹽後溫熱食用；不包含帕瑪森起司、瓶裝義大利麵醬或未秤重的烹調油。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and other seasonings.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與其他調味料也一併調整。

label.en: Cottage cheese, banana and berries with whole-wheat bread — standard recipe
label.zh: 茅屋起司香蕉藍莓全麥麵包餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses plain unsweetened cottage cheese with 2% milkfat, whole banana and blueberries, and the specific ready-to-eat whole-wheat French/Vienna bread. The bread is not additionally toasted; no butter, jam or honey is included. Use dairy cottage cheese without hydrolysed lactose, whey powder or fruit preparation. Fruit is served in intact pieces, not blended.
notes.zh: 使用原味無加糖 2% 乳脂茅屋起司、完整香蕉與藍莓，以及指定即食全麥法式／維也納麵包。麵包不另烘烤，不含奶油、果醬或蜂蜜。茅屋起司須不含水解乳糖、乳清粉或水果調製物；水果保持完整塊狀，不攪打。

instructions.en: Measure the plain 2%-milkfat cottage cheese and slice the specified ready-to-eat whole-wheat bread. Keep the cottage cheese according to its storage instructions.
instructions.zh: 按所選份量秤取原味 2% 乳脂茅屋起司與指定即食全麥麵包，茅屋起司依其保存指示處理。

instructions.en: Peel and weigh the banana before slicing it. Wash, drain and weigh the whole blueberries, then place both fruits beside the cottage cheese.
instructions.zh: 香蕉去皮秤重後切片；完整藍莓洗淨瀝乾秤重，兩種水果放在茅屋起司旁。

instructions.en: Serve with the bread while the dairy remains chilled. Use only the listed foods; fruit syrup or other toppings change the calculation.
instructions.zh: 乳製品保持冷藏食用狀態，搭配麵包；只使用表列食材，額外果糖漿或配料會改變計算。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and other seasonings.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與其他調味料也一併調整。

label.en: Water-cooked oats with boiled egg and banana — standard recipe
label.zh: 水煮燕麥佐水煮蛋與香蕉（標準配方）

notes.en: This source-matched version uses plain water-cooked oats, peeled hard-boiled egg and raw banana. It omits the soy drink in the legacy idea because the archived generic soy-drink source has an unresolved FVNS proportion and interpretation; unknown is not treated as zero. The cooked-oat weight already includes its cooking water. Banana is the only qualifying FVNS ingredient and is weighed raw. No milk, soy drink, sweetener or topping is included.
notes.zh: 此來源對應版本使用原味水煮燕麥、去殼水煮蛋與生香蕉。舊構想中的豆飲未納入，因保留的一般豆飲來源之 FVNS 比例與判讀未解決，未知值不視為零。熟燕麥重量已包含其煮食水分；香蕉是唯一合格 FVNS 食材，採生重。不含牛奶、豆飲、甜味料或配料。

instructions.en: Prepare plain oats with water and no salt, then weigh the cooked amount in the selected-portion list. The cooked weight includes retained cooking water.
instructions.zh: 原味燕麥以水煮熟、不加鹽，按所選份量清單秤取熟重；熟重已包含保留的煮食水分。

instructions.en: Peel and weigh the prepared hard-boiled egg. Peel the banana and weigh its raw edible flesh before slicing it.
instructions.zh: 已煮熟水煮蛋去殼後秤重；香蕉去皮後秤取可食生重，再切片。

instructions.en: Serve the oats with the sliced egg and banana. Keep the banana in pieces rather than blending it into the porridge; no milk or soy drink is included.
instructions.zh: 燕麥搭配切片水煮蛋與香蕉食用，香蕉保持塊狀、不攪打進燕麥；此配方不含牛奶或豆飲。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for all three ingredients. Additional milk, soy drink, syrup or toppings change the estimate.
instructions.zh: 三項食材皆採所選份量清單的克數；額外牛奶、豆飲、糖漿或配料會改變估算。

label.en: Chicken, kale and white bean soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞肉羽衣甘藍白菜豆湯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses roasted skinless chicken and separately cooked unsalted white beans, boiled drained kale and onion. The listed water is retained and eaten as part of the soup. This is not canned soup or a stock-concentrate estimate; no cream, bouillon, extra broth or sweetener is included. All qualifying FVNS ingredients are weighed cooked.
notes.zh: 使用去皮烤雞胸、另煮的無鹽白菜豆、水煮瀝乾羽衣甘藍與洋蔥。表列水保留在湯內並食用；這不是罐頭湯或濃縮湯底估算，不含鮮奶油、湯塊、額外高湯或甜味料。合格 FVNS 食材均採熟重。

instructions.en: Shred the prepared roasted chicken. Weigh the boiled drained white beans, kale and onion at their listed cooked amounts.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟雞肉撕成絲；白菜豆、羽衣甘藍與洋蔥水煮瀝乾後，按表列熟重秤量。

instructions.en: Place the weighed cooked ingredients in a bowl and add the listed amount of hot drinking water. Stir in the measured olive oil and salt.
instructions.zh: 秤好的熟食材放入碗中，加入表列熱飲用水，再拌入橄欖油與鹽。

instructions.en: Serve warm with all liquid included. If reheating evaporates water, replenish it to the selected recipe amount; discarded cooking water does not count.
instructions.zh: 溫熱食用並喝完全部湯水；若加熱蒸發水分，補回所選配方水量，已倒掉的煮食水不計入。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and other seasonings.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與其他調味料也一併調整。

label.en: Lean beef and cooked tomato rice bowl with cabbage — standard recipe
label.zh: 瘦牛肉熟番茄高麗菜飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses grilled lean top-round beef, cooked rice, cooked tomato pieces and boiled drained cabbage. It is not a sauced stir-fry estimate. Tomato remains in recognizable pieces; no tomato puree, concentrated paste, ketchup, soy sauce or added sweetener is included. Qualifying vegetables share a cooked-weight basis.
notes.zh: 使用去除可見脂肪的烤牛後腿肉（top round）、熟白飯、熟番茄塊與水煮瀝乾高麗菜，不是有醬汁的炒牛肉估算。番茄保留可辨識塊狀，不含番茄泥、濃縮糊、番茄醬、醬油或添加甜味料。合格蔬菜均採熟重。

instructions.en: Slice prepared grilled lean beef after removing visible fat. Weigh the cooked rice, plain cooked tomato pieces and boiled drained cabbage.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟牛肉去除可見脂肪後切片；秤取熟白飯、原味熟番茄塊與水煮瀝乾高麗菜。

instructions.en: Arrange the beef and cooked tomato over the rice and add the cabbage on the side. Keep the tomato in pieces.
instructions.zh: 牛肉與熟番茄放在白飯上，高麗菜放旁邊；番茄維持塊狀。

instructions.en: Add all of the measured olive oil and salt and serve warm. Extra marinades, cooking oil or sauces are outside the calculation.
instructions.zh: 加入全部表列橄欖油與鹽後溫熱食用；額外醃料、烹調油或醬汁未列入計算。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and other seasonings.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與其他調味料也一併調整。

label.en: Cooked shrimp and baked potato with red pepper and onion — standard recipe
label.zh: 熟蝦仁烤馬鈴薯紅甜椒洋蔥餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: This explicit variation uses moist-heat cooked shrimp, baked skin-on potato, and boiled drained red pepper and onion rather than seared fajita vegetables. The shrimp source may contain moisture-retention additives and reports 947 mg sodium/100 g; that value is retained, with no additional salt in this recipe. No tortilla, seasoning packet or sauce is included.
notes.zh: 此明示版本以濕熱熟蝦仁、帶皮烤馬鈴薯及水煮瀝乾紅甜椒、洋蔥，取代煎炒法士達蔬菜。蝦來源可能含保水添加物，每 100 克鈉 947 毫克，完整保留該值；此配方不另加鹽。不含餅皮、調味包或醬汁。

instructions.en: Weigh the specified cooked peeled shrimp, baked potato with edible skin, and separately boiled drained red pepper and onion.
instructions.zh: 秤取指定去殼熟蝦仁、含可食皮的烤馬鈴薯，以及分別水煮瀝乾的紅甜椒與洋蔥。

instructions.en: Cut the potato into pieces and arrange it with the shrimp and vegetables on a plate.
instructions.zh: 馬鈴薯切塊後，與熟蝦仁及蔬菜一起盛盤。

instructions.en: Add all of the measured olive oil and serve warm. Do not add salt within this recipe; extra seasoning changes the sodium estimate.
instructions.zh: 加入全部表列橄欖油後溫熱食用；此配方不另加鹽，額外調味會改變鈉估算。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and other seasonings.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與其他調味料也一併調整。

label.en: Roasted chicken with sweetcorn and green beans — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤雞胸甜玉米四季豆餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses plain roasted skinless breast rather than an unspecified seasoned rotisserie chicken. Sweetcorn kernels and green snap beans are boiled and drained without salt before the listed seasoning is added. Corn is weighed off the cob; it is the starchy side for this plate and qualifies as whole sweetcorn in the FVNS calculation. No butter, seasoning packet or sauce is included.
notes.zh: 使用原味去皮烤雞胸，不代表調味未明的旋轉烤雞。甜玉米粒與四季豆先無鹽水煮瀝乾，再加入表列調味料。玉米秤重不含梗，作為此餐盤的澱粉配菜，並以完整甜玉米納入 FVNS。不含奶油、調味包或醬汁。

instructions.en: Prepare roasted skinless chicken breast, boiled drained sweetcorn and boiled drained green beans. Remove the corn cob and weigh only the cooked edible kernels.
instructions.zh: 備妥去皮烤雞胸、水煮瀝乾甜玉米與四季豆；玉米去梗後只秤可食熟玉米粒。

instructions.en: Slice the chicken and place it beside the selected amounts of corn and green beans.
instructions.zh: 雞肉切片後，與所選份量的玉米粒及四季豆一起盛盤。

instructions.en: Add all the measured olive oil and salt and serve warm. The assembly estimate starts with the ingredients already cooked.
instructions.zh: 加入全部表列橄欖油與鹽後溫熱食用；組合時間從食材已煮熟後開始。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一併調整。

label.en: Roasted chicken and rice with lemon salad — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤雞胸白飯佐檸檬沙拉（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses the plain roasted skinless chicken record, not a generic seasoned rotisserie product. The salad is raw romaine, tomato and cucumber. All qualifying FVNS ingredients, including the fresh lemon juice, use raw weights; rice and chicken do not enter that numerator. Lemon-juice sugars are counted as free sugars. No bottled dressing or marinade is included.
notes.zh: 使用原味去皮烤雞胸來源，不代表一般調味旋轉烤雞。沙拉為生蘿蔓、番茄與小黃瓜；含新鮮檸檬汁在內的合格 FVNS 食材皆採生重，白飯與雞肉不納入其分子。檸檬汁中的糖計入游離糖，不含瓶裝沙拉醬或醃料。

instructions.en: Weigh the prepared roasted chicken and cooked rice, then slice the chicken. Wash, drain and weigh the raw romaine, tomato and cucumber.
instructions.zh: 秤取已烤熟雞胸與熟白飯，雞肉切片；蘿蔓、番茄與小黃瓜洗淨瀝乾後秤生重。

instructions.en: Arrange the chicken and rice on a plate and place the raw vegetables alongside.
instructions.zh: 雞肉與白飯盛盤，生蔬菜放旁邊。

instructions.en: Mix the measured lemon juice, olive oil and salt and use all of it on the salad. Serve without extra sauces.
instructions.zh: 將表列檸檬汁、橄欖油與鹽拌勻，全部用於沙拉，不另加醬汁。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一併調整。

label.en: Beef, boiled egg and mixed-vegetable rice bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 牛肉水煮蛋綜合蔬菜飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: A defined variation of the bibimbap idea with grilled lean top-round beef, hard-boiled egg and boiled drained zucchini, carrot and spinach. It does not estimate a fried egg, sauteed vegetables or gochujang sauce. All qualifying vegetables use cooked weights. Sesame oil, chili paste, soy sauce and extra garnish are not included.
notes.zh: 此拌飯構想的定量版本使用去除可見脂肪的烤牛後腿肉（top round）、水煮蛋、水煮瀝乾櫛瓜、紅蘿蔔與菠菜；不估算煎蛋、炒蔬菜或韓式辣椒醬。合格蔬菜皆採熟重，不含芝麻油、辣椒醬、醬油或額外配料。

instructions.en: Slice the prepared grilled lean beef and peeled hard-boiled egg. Weigh the cooked rice and the separately boiled and drained vegetables.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟瘦牛肉與去殼水煮蛋切片；秤取熟白飯及分別水煮瀝乾的蔬菜。

instructions.en: Place the rice in a bowl and arrange the beef, egg, zucchini, carrot and spinach over it.
instructions.zh: 白飯盛碗，放上牛肉、蛋、櫛瓜、紅蘿蔔與菠菜。

instructions.en: Add the measured olive oil and salt, then mix and serve warm. Keep all listed ingredients in the bowl; extra condiments change the estimate.
instructions.zh: 加入表列橄欖油與鹽，拌勻後溫熱食用；表列食材全部保留，額外調味料會改變估算。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一併調整。

label.en: Turkey, beans and cooked-tomato rice bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 火雞雙豆熟番茄飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: This explicit version uses roasted turkey breast, whole unsalted white and black turtle beans, cooked tomato pieces, red pepper and onion. It is not an estimate of packaged chili, ground turkey or chili sauce. Tomato remains in recognizable pieces, not puree or concentrated paste; all qualifying FVNS ingredients are weighed cooked. No seasoning packet or sweetener is included.
notes.zh: 此明示版本使用烤火雞胸、完整無鹽白菜豆與黑菜豆、熟番茄塊、紅甜椒與洋蔥，不估算包裝辣肉醬、火雞絞肉或辣椒醬。番茄維持可辨識塊狀，不是果泥或濃縮糊；合格 FVNS 食材均採熟重。不含調味包或甜味料。

instructions.en: Dice the prepared roasted turkey. Weigh the cooked rice, drained beans, cooked tomato pieces, and boiled drained red pepper and onion.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟火雞肉切丁；秤取熟白飯、瀝乾豆類、熟番茄塊及水煮瀝乾紅甜椒與洋蔥。

instructions.en: Combine the turkey, beans and vegetables over the rice without blending the tomato into a sauce.
instructions.zh: 火雞、豆類與蔬菜放在白飯上混合，番茄不攪打成醬。

instructions.en: Stir in all the measured olive oil and salt and serve warm. No unmeasured stock, chili paste or sauce is part of this bowl.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部表列橄欖油與鹽後溫熱食用；此碗不含未秤重高湯、辣椒糊或醬汁。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一併調整。

label.en: Avocado and egg with whole-wheat bread and potato soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 酪梨水煮蛋全麥麵包佐馬鈴薯湯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses sliced raw avocado, hard-boiled egg and the specific ready-to-eat whole-wheat French/Vienna bread, without further toasting. The side soup contains the listed baked potato with edible skin, retained drinking water, oil and salt; it contains no cream or stock. Its final potato-plus-water weight is the sum of those selected ingredient amounts, with evaporation replenished. Potato does not qualify as FVNS, so avocado is the only qualifying raw ingredient.
notes.zh: 使用生酪梨切片、水煮蛋及指定即食全麥法式／維也納麵包，不另烘烤。旁邊的湯含表列帶可食皮烤馬鈴薯、保留飲用水、油與鹽，不含鮮奶油或高湯。湯中馬鈴薯加水的最終重量為兩者所選份量之和，蒸發水分須補回；馬鈴薯不納入 FVNS，因此酪梨是唯一合格的生食材。

instructions.en: Remove the avocado skin and stone and weigh the raw flesh before slicing. Peel and weigh the hard-boiled egg, and measure the specified ready-to-eat bread.
instructions.zh: 酪梨去皮去核後秤生果肉並切片；水煮蛋去殼後秤重，另秤指定即食麵包。

instructions.en: Cut the prepared baked potato, retaining its edible skin. Add the measured hot water and replenish evaporation so potato plus retained water matches their listed combined weight. Then add the measured oil and salt.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟馬鈴薯連可食皮切塊，加入表列熱水並補回蒸發水分，使馬鈴薯與保留水的合計重量符合清單，再加入表列油與鹽。

instructions.en: Serve the sliced avocado and egg on or beside the bread, with the warm chunky potato soup. Consume all listed soup liquid; no milk, butter or extra topping is included.
instructions.zh: 酪梨片與蛋放在麵包上或旁邊，搭配溫熱馬鈴薯塊湯，表列湯水全部食用；不含牛奶、奶油或額外配料。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一併調整。

label.en: Turkey-avocado sandwich with potato soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 火雞酪梨三明治佐馬鈴薯湯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses roasted turkey breast rather than deli slices, raw avocado and romaine, and the specific whole-wheat French/Vienna bread. The soup is baked skin-on potato with measured retained water, oil and salt, not canned or cream soup. Restore evaporation so potato plus water equals their selected combined weights before seasoning. Potato is excluded from the FVNS numerator; avocado and romaine use raw weights. No mayonnaise or cheese is included.
notes.zh: 使用烤火雞胸而非冷切片，搭配生酪梨、蘿蔓及指定全麥法式／維也納麵包。湯為帶皮烤馬鈴薯加上秤重保留水、油與鹽，不是罐頭湯或奶油濃湯。補回蒸發水分，使調味前馬鈴薯加水等於兩者所選份量之和。馬鈴薯不納入 FVNS 分子，酪梨與蘿蔓採生重。不含美乃滋或起司。

instructions.en: Slice the prepared turkey and measured bread. Remove avocado skin and stone, then weigh and slice the flesh; wash, drain and weigh the romaine.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟火雞肉與秤好的麵包切片；酪梨去皮去核後秤重切片，蘿蔓洗淨瀝乾後秤重。

instructions.en: Layer the turkey, avocado and romaine inside the bread. Keep all of the selected filling amounts in the sandwich.
instructions.zh: 將火雞肉、酪梨與蘿蔓夾入麵包，完整使用所選內餡份量。

instructions.en: Cut the baked potato with its edible skin and add the measured hot water. Replenish evaporated water to the specified retained amount, then add the measured oil and salt and serve the sandwich with all of the soup.
instructions.zh: 帶可食皮烤馬鈴薯切塊，加入表列熱水並補回蒸發水分至指定保留量，再加入油與鹽；三明治搭配全部湯品食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一併調整。

label.en: Lean beef, tomato and napa cabbage noodle soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 瘦牛肉番茄大白菜湯麵（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses grilled lean top-round beef, cooked enriched egg noodles, cooked tomato pieces and boiled drained napa cabbage. It is not braised beef broth. Tomato remains in pieces, without puree, ketchup or concentrated paste. All qualifying vegetables use cooked weights; the separately listed water is retained and consumed, with evaporation restored. No stock concentrate or soy sauce is included.
notes.zh: 使用去除可見脂肪的烤牛後腿肉（top round）、熟營養強化雞蛋麵、熟番茄塊與水煮瀝乾大白菜，不是燉牛肉湯底。番茄保持塊狀，不含果泥、番茄醬或濃縮糊；合格蔬菜皆採熟重，另列的水保留並食用，蒸發量補回。不含濃縮高湯或醬油。

instructions.en: Slice the prepared lean grilled beef. Weigh the cooked egg noodles, cooked tomato pieces and boiled drained napa cabbage.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟瘦牛肉切片；秤取熟雞蛋麵、熟番茄塊與水煮瀝乾大白菜。

instructions.en: Combine the prepared ingredients with the selected amount of hot water. Add the measured olive oil and salt without reducing the soup.
instructions.zh: 熟食材加入所選份量熱水，再加入表列橄欖油與鹽，不將湯收乾。

instructions.en: Serve warm with all the listed liquid. If reheating evaporates water, replenish it to the specified retained amount; discarded noodle-cooking water is not counted.
instructions.zh: 溫熱食用並喝完表列湯水；若加熱使水分蒸發，補回指定保留量，已倒掉的煮麵水不計入。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一併調整。

label.en: Baked salmon and chickpeas with zucchini and red pepper — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤鮭魚鷹嘴豆櫛瓜紅甜椒餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses dry-heat-cooked farmed Atlantic salmon, whole boiled chickpeas, and boiled drained skin-on zucchini and red pepper. All qualifying FVNS ingredients use cooked weights. This plate contains no pita, rice, hummus, raw salad, lemon juice or prepared sauce.
notes.zh: 使用乾熱烹調的養殖大西洋鮭魚、完整水煮鷹嘴豆、水煮瀝乾帶皮櫛瓜與紅甜椒；合格 FVNS 食材皆採熟重。不含口袋餅、白飯、鷹嘴豆泥、生沙拉、檸檬汁或調製醬汁。

instructions.en: Prepare the baked salmon and remove bones and inedible parts. Weigh the cooked fish, boiled chickpeas and separately boiled drained zucchini and red pepper.
instructions.zh: 備妥烤鮭魚並去除骨頭與不可食部分；秤取熟魚、水煮鷹嘴豆及分別水煮瀝乾的櫛瓜、紅甜椒。

instructions.en: Arrange the salmon over or beside the chickpeas and vegetables on a plate.
instructions.zh: 鮭魚放在鷹嘴豆與蔬菜上或旁邊，一起盛盤。

instructions.en: Add all of the measured olive oil and salt and serve warm. Additional dressings or marinades are not part of the calculation.
instructions.zh: 加入全部表列橄欖油與鹽後溫熱食用；額外沙拉醬或醃料未列入計算。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一併調整。

label.en: Roasted turkey rice with bok choy and mushrooms — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤火雞肉飯佐青江菜蘑菇（標準配方）

notes.en: A plain source-matched turkey rice plate using roasted skinless breast, boiled drained bok choy and white mushrooms. It does not estimate the turkey-fat gravy, fried shallots or soy-sauce dressing used in some Taiwanese turkey rice preparations. All oil and salt are explicitly listed; qualifying vegetables are weighed cooked.
notes.zh: 此原味來源對應火雞肉飯使用去皮烤火雞胸、水煮瀝乾青江菜與白蘑菇；不估算部分臺式火雞肉飯使用的火雞油醬汁、油蔥酥或醬油調味汁。油鹽全部明列，合格蔬菜採熟重。

instructions.en: Shred the prepared roasted turkey breast. Weigh the cooked white rice, boiled drained bok choy and boiled drained mushrooms.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟火雞胸撕成絲；秤取熟白飯、水煮瀝乾青江菜與蘑菇。

instructions.en: Place the turkey over the rice and serve the bok choy and mushrooms alongside.
instructions.zh: 火雞肉鋪在白飯上，青江菜與蘑菇放旁邊。

instructions.en: Add the measured olive oil and salt and serve warm without extra gravy or fried toppings.
instructions.zh: 加入表列橄欖油與鹽後溫熱食用，不另加醬汁或油炸配料。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一併調整。

label.en: Boiled egg and bitter melon rice plate — standard recipe
label.zh: 水煮蛋苦瓜飯餐盤（標準配方）
