notes.en: Uses hard-boiled egg and boiled drained bitter-gourd fruit with onion, not scrambled eggs or stir-fried bitter melon. The source is bitter-gourd fruit (pods), not leafy tips. Seeds and inedible parts are removed before the final edible cooked weight. The recipe includes no salted soaking liquid, fermented beans or sauce; all qualifying vegetables use cooked weights.
notes.zh: 使用水煮蛋、水煮瀝乾苦瓜果肉與洋蔥，不是苦瓜炒蛋。來源為苦瓜果實（pods），不是嫩葉；去除籽與不可食部分後秤可食熟重。不含鹽水浸泡液、發酵豆類或醬汁，合格蔬菜皆採熟重。

instructions.en: Prepare hard-boiled eggs and cooked rice. Remove bitter-melon seeds and inedible parts, then boil and drain the fruit and onion without salt.
instructions.zh: 備妥水煮蛋與白飯；苦瓜去籽及不可食部分，果肉與洋蔥以無鹽水煮熟瀝乾。

instructions.en: Weigh the peeled egg and the cooked edible rice, bitter melon and onion at the selected amounts. Slice the egg and arrange everything on a plate.
instructions.zh: 去殼蛋與熟白飯、可食熟苦瓜及洋蔥按所選份量秤重，蛋切片後一起盛盤。

instructions.en: Add all measured olive oil and salt and serve warm. Salted soaking, frying oil or added sauces would change the source match.
instructions.zh: 加入全部表列橄欖油與鹽後溫熱食用；鹽水浸泡、額外煎炸用油或醬汁會改變來源對應。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一併調整。

label.en: Cooked-salmon rice bowl with avocado and cucumber — standard recipe
label.zh: 熟鮭魚酪梨小黃瓜飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: This version of the poke idea uses fully dry-heat-cooked farmed Atlantic salmon, served cooled; it is not raw-fish poke. Avocado, cucumber, romaine and fresh lemon juice are weighed raw, while fish and rice do not contribute to the FVNS numerator. Lemon-juice sugars count as free sugars. No mayonnaise, soy sauce, sesame, sweetened sushi-rice seasoning or added oil is included.
notes.zh: 此 poke 構想版本使用乾熱完全煮熟的養殖大西洋鮭魚，冷卻食用，不是生魚 poke。酪梨、小黃瓜、蘿蔓及新鮮檸檬汁皆採生重，魚與飯不納入 FVNS 分子。檸檬汁的糖計入游離糖；不含美乃滋、醬油、芝麻、含糖壽司飯調味料或額外油。

instructions.en: Weigh the cooked salmon and plain cooked rice, then cool them according to their storage instructions. Remove fish bones and inedible parts.
instructions.zh: 秤取熟鮭魚與原味熟白飯，依保存指示冷卻，魚肉去除骨頭及不可食部分。

instructions.en: Remove avocado skin and stone before weighing its flesh. Wash, drain and weigh cucumber and romaine; arrange these raw ingredients with the cooled fish and rice.
instructions.zh: 酪梨去皮去核後秤果肉；小黃瓜與蘿蔓洗淨瀝乾後秤重，與冷卻的魚和飯一起盛碗。

instructions.en: Mix the measured lemon juice and salt and use all of it on the bowl. Serve chilled without extra sauces or oil.
instructions.zh: 表列檸檬汁與鹽拌勻後全部淋入碗中，冷食且不另加醬汁或油。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一併調整。

label.en: Chicken, black bean and sweetcorn rice bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞肉黑菜豆甜玉米飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: A defined version of the taco-rice idea using roasted skinless chicken, whole black turtle beans, boiled sweetcorn kernels and boiled drained red pepper. This is not a calculation for taco-seasoning packets, salsa, tortillas or sour cream. Corn is weighed off the cob and all qualifying FVNS ingredients use cooked weights.
notes.zh: 此 taco 飯構想的定量版本使用去皮烤雞胸、完整黑菜豆、水煮甜玉米粒與水煮瀝乾紅甜椒；不估算 taco 調味包、莎莎醬、餅皮或酸奶。玉米秤重不含梗，合格 FVNS 食材皆採熟重。

instructions.en: Prepare and weigh the roasted chicken, cooked rice and plain boiled black turtle beans. Boil and drain the sweetcorn and red pepper, removing the corn cob before weighing.
instructions.zh: 備妥並秤取烤雞肉、熟白飯與原味水煮黑菜豆；甜玉米與紅甜椒水煮瀝乾，玉米去梗後秤重。

instructions.en: Dice the chicken and arrange it with the beans, corn and red pepper over the rice.
instructions.zh: 雞肉切丁後，與豆類、玉米及紅甜椒放在白飯上。

instructions.en: Mix in all the measured olive oil and salt and serve warm. Extra spice packets, sauces or toppings change the estimate.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部表列橄欖油與鹽後溫熱食用；額外香料包、醬汁或配料會改變估算。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion ingredient list for every amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材都採用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一併調整。

label.en: Grilled chicken, kale and green bean rice plate — standard recipe
label.zh: 炙烤雞胸羽衣甘藍四季豆飯餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses plain grilled skinless boneless chicken, not the roasted or added-solution chicken records. Kale and green beans are boiled without salt and drained before weighing. All qualifying vegetables use cooked weights; the measured oil and salt are the entire seasoning. Assembly time starts with cooked ingredients.
notes.zh: 使用原味去皮去骨炙烤雞胸，不套用烘烤雞胸或添加溶液雞胸資料。羽衣甘藍與四季豆無鹽水煮、瀝乾後秤重，合格蔬菜皆採熟重。表列油鹽即全部調味；組裝時間從已有熟食材起算。

instructions.en: Slice the prepared grilled chicken breast and weigh its edible cooked meat. Weigh the cooked white rice.
instructions.zh: 已炙烤熟雞胸切片後秤可食熟肉，另秤熟白飯。

instructions.en: Boil kale and green beans without salt, drain well, and weigh the selected cooked amounts. Serve them beside the chicken and rice.
instructions.zh: 羽衣甘藍與四季豆無鹽水煮、充分瀝乾後按所選熟重秤取，與雞肉及飯一起盛盤。

instructions.en: Distribute all measured olive oil and salt over the vegetables and chicken; serve warm.
instructions.zh: 把表列橄欖油與鹽全部拌入蔬菜及雞肉，溫熱食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材均使用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一起調整。

label.en: Boiled egg, tomato, wholewheat bread and blueberry plate — standard recipe
label.zh: 水煮蛋番茄全麥麵包藍莓餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: An explicitly boiled-egg version of the egg-and-bread idea: the source does not support an omelet with unspecified milk or cooking fat. Bread is whole-wheat French/Vienna bread, weighed as supplied and not estimated as toast. Keep tomato and blueberries raw and do not add butter, jam, frying oil or sugar.
notes.zh: 此蛋與麵包構想明確採水煮蛋版本；來源不足以支持牛奶或烹調油未知的歐姆蛋。麵包為全麥法式／維也納麵包，按供應狀態秤重，不估算烤吐司。番茄與藍莓保持生鮮，不加奶油、果醬、煎油或糖。

instructions.en: Peel the prepared hard-boiled eggs, weigh them and cut into wedges. Weigh the wholewheat bread without toasting.
instructions.zh: 備妥水煮蛋去殼秤重後切塊，另秤未再烘烤的全麥麵包。

instructions.en: Wash and drain the tomato and blueberries, remove inedible parts and weigh their raw edible portions.
instructions.zh: 番茄與藍莓洗淨瀝乾，去除不可食部分後秤生可食重量。

instructions.en: Arrange the egg, bread, tomato and berries on a plate. Add the measured salt to the egg and tomato.
instructions.zh: 蛋、麵包、番茄與藍莓一起盛盤，表列鹽分配至蛋與番茄。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材均使用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一起調整。

label.en: Lean beef rice-noodle soup with fresh parsley and scallion — standard recipe
label.zh: 瘦牛肉米粉湯佐新鮮巴西里青蔥（標準配方）

notes.en: A defined plain beef rice-noodle soup inspired by the pho idea, using cooked lean top-round beef, prepared rice noodles and retained drinking water. It does not estimate bone broth, fish sauce, spice stock or restaurant pho. Parsley, scallion and cucumber are weighed raw and served separately after heating so all qualifying vegetables retain one raw-weight basis.
notes.zh: 此越南河粉構想採定量原味牛肉米粉湯，使用去除可見脂肪的烤牛後腿肉（top round）、熟米粉與保留於湯中的飲用水，不估算骨湯、魚露、香料高湯或餐廳河粉。巴西里、青蔥及小黃瓜採生重，在湯加熱後另外盛放，使合格蔬菜維持單一生重基準。

instructions.en: Slice and weigh the cooked lean beef. Drain and weigh the prepared rice noodles, then warm both the beef and noodles with the listed drinking water.
instructions.zh: 已熟瘦牛肉切片秤重，熟米粉瀝乾秤重後，把牛肉與米粉一起加入表列飲用水溫熱。

instructions.en: Before seasoning, restore evaporated water until the soup weighs the listed beef, noodles and water combined. Stir in all measured oil and salt.
instructions.zh: 調味前補回蒸發水，使湯的重量等於表列牛肉、米粉與水的合計，再拌入全部表列油鹽。

instructions.en: Wash, drain and weigh the parsley, scallion and cucumber. Chop or slice and serve them raw beside the warm soup; do not simmer them in it.
instructions.zh: 巴西里、青蔥與小黃瓜洗淨瀝乾秤重，切碎或切片後以生食小碟搭配熱湯，不放入湯中煮。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材均使用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一起調整。

label.en: Tuna rice bowl with potato soup and banana — standard recipe
label.zh: 鮪魚飯碗佐馬鈴薯湯與香蕉（標準配方）

notes.en: A rice-bowl variation of the onigiri idea: the source is cooked long-grain white rice, not sticky sushi rice, so the recipe does not promise shaped rice balls. Use drained light tuna canned in water without added salt, with no mayonnaise, seaweed or sweetened rice dressing. The side soup uses baked potato flesh and skin with retained water, not canned soup or a boiled-potato record. Banana is the only qualifying FVNS ingredient and is weighed raw without peel.
notes.zh: 此飯糰構想改為飯碗：來源是煮熟長粒白飯，不是黏性壽司米，因此不承諾能捏成飯糰。使用未加鹽水浸淡色鮪魚罐頭的瀝乾肉，不含美乃滋、海苔或含糖飯調味汁。配湯採含皮烤馬鈴薯與保留水，不套用罐頭湯或水煮馬鈴薯資料。香蕉為唯一合格 FVNS 食材，去皮秤生重。

instructions.en: Drain and weigh the water-packed tuna. Weigh the cooked long-grain white rice and spoon the tuna over it in a bowl.
instructions.zh: 水浸鮪魚瀝乾秤重；秤取熟長粒白飯盛碗，再放上鮪魚。

instructions.en: Dice the weighed baked potato with skin and heat with the listed water. Before adding salt, restore evaporated water to the listed potato-plus-water mass.
instructions.zh: 秤取含皮烤馬鈴薯切丁，加入表列水加熱；加鹽前補回蒸發水至表列馬鈴薯與水的合計重量。

instructions.en: Use all measured salt in the soup. Peel and weigh the banana, then serve it with the tuna rice bowl and soup.
instructions.zh: 把表列鹽全部加入湯中；香蕉去皮秤重，與鮪魚飯碗及湯一起上桌。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材均使用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一起調整。

label.en: Chicken wholewheat sandwich with baked-potato soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞肉全麥三明治佐烤馬鈴薯湯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses plain grilled chicken and whole-wheat French/Vienna bread with raw tomato and romaine. The soup contains baked potato flesh and skin plus retained water; no commercial soup, mayonnaise, cheese or butter is represented. Qualifying vegetables are raw; potato, meat and grain do not enter the FVNS numerator.
notes.zh: 使用原味炙烤雞胸、全麥法式／維也納麵包及生番茄、蘿蔓。湯含帶皮烤馬鈴薯與保留水，不代表市售濃湯、美乃滋、起司或奶油。合格蔬菜皆採生重；馬鈴薯、肉及穀物不納入 FVNS 分子。

instructions.en: Weigh and slice the prepared grilled chicken and wholewheat bread. Wash, drain and weigh the raw tomato and romaine.
instructions.zh: 秤取已炙烤熟雞胸與全麥麵包並切片，生番茄與蘿蔓洗淨瀝乾後秤重。

instructions.en: Heat the weighed baked potato with the listed water. Restore evaporated water to the combined potato-plus-water mass, then add the measured salt.
instructions.zh: 秤取烤馬鈴薯與表列水一起加熱，補回蒸發水至馬鈴薯與水的合計重量，再加入表列鹽。

instructions.en: Use all measured olive oil on the bread and fill with chicken, tomato and romaine. Serve with the warm potato soup.
instructions.zh: 表列橄欖油全部淋在麵包上，夾入雞肉、番茄與蘿蔓，搭配溫熱馬鈴薯湯。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材均使用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一起調整。

label.en: Roast lamb rice bowl with cucumber, parsley and yogurt — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤羊腿小黃瓜巴西里優格飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: A whole-cut roast-lamb version of the gyro-bowl idea, not a processed gyro-meat estimate. Weigh only cooked lean lamb leg without bone or separable fat. Cucumber, tomato, chopped parsley and lemon juice use raw weights. Plain nonfat Greek yogurt is unsweetened; lemon-juice sugars count as free sugars. No unlisted marinade, pita or prepared tzatziki is included.
notes.zh: 此 gyro 碗構想採原塊烤羊肉版本，不估算加工 gyro 肉。僅秤去骨、去可分離脂肪的熟羊腿瘦肉。小黃瓜、番茄、切碎巴西里及檸檬汁採生重。原味無脂希臘優格不加糖，檸檬汁的糖計入游離糖；不含未列出的醃料、皮塔餅或預製 tzatziki 醬。

instructions.en: Remove bone and separable fat from the prepared roast lamb leg, then weigh and slice the cooked lean meat. Weigh the cooked rice.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟羊腿去骨及可分離脂肪，秤取熟瘦肉切片，另秤熟白飯。

instructions.en: Wash and drain the cucumber, tomato and parsley. Weigh and chop them, then arrange raw beside the lamb and rice.
instructions.zh: 小黃瓜、番茄與巴西里洗淨瀝乾，秤重切碎後以生食搭配羊肉與飯。

instructions.en: Mix the measured plain yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil and salt. Serve all of this dressing with the bowl.
instructions.zh: 表列原味優格、檸檬汁、橄欖油與鹽拌勻，全部搭配飯碗食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材均使用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一起調整。

label.en: Warm shrimp, sweetcorn and vegetable rice — standard recipe
label.zh: 溫拌蝦仁甜玉米蔬菜飯（標準配方）

notes.en: This warm assembled version of the shrimp-rice idea uses moist-heat-cooked shrimp and separately boiled vegetables, not an estimate for restaurant fried rice. The shrimp source can contain moisture-retention additives and reports 947 mg sodium per 100 g; that sodium remains in the calculation. All qualifying vegetables use cooked weights. No egg, soy sauce or unlisted frying oil is included.
notes.zh: 此蝦仁飯構想為溫拌組裝版本，使用濕熱煮熟蝦仁與分別水煮的蔬菜，不估算餐廳炒飯。蝦仁來源可能含保水添加物，每 100 克鈉為 947 毫克，計算保留此鈉值。合格蔬菜皆採熟重，不含蛋、醬油或未列出的炒油。

instructions.en: Prepare the moist-heat-cooked shrimp and plain cooked rice. Warm them and weigh the final edible cooked portions without shells or tails.
instructions.zh: 備妥濕熱煮熟蝦仁與原味熟飯，溫熱後秤最終可食熟重，蝦仁不含殼與尾。

instructions.en: Boil and drain sweetcorn kernels, carrots and spinach without salt. Weigh their cooked portions and combine with the warm rice and shrimp.
instructions.zh: 甜玉米粒、胡蘿蔔與菠菜無鹽水煮瀝乾，秤熟重後與溫熱飯及蝦仁混合。

instructions.en: Off the heat, fold in all measured olive oil and salt. Serve without extra stir-frying or sauces.
instructions.zh: 離火後拌入全部表列橄欖油與鹽，不再額外炒製或加醬。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材均使用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一起調整。

label.en: Shredded chicken rice with raw scallion and cucumber — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞絲飯佐生青蔥小黃瓜（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses shredded roasted skinless chicken breast with plain rice and a raw scallion-cucumber side. It does not estimate a shop's chicken-fat sauce, fried shallots or soy-sauce dressing. Scallion and cucumber are weighed raw and are not cooked into the rice; all listed oil and salt are consumed.
notes.zh: 使用撕絲的去皮烤雞胸、原味飯與生青蔥小黃瓜配菜，不估算店家的雞油醬、油蔥酥或醬油調味汁。青蔥及小黃瓜採生重，不放入飯中烹煮，表列油鹽全部食用。

instructions.en: Weigh and shred the prepared roasted chicken breast. Place it over the selected amount of cooked white rice.
instructions.zh: 秤取已烤熟雞胸並撕絲，放在所選份量的熟白飯上。

instructions.en: Wash, drain and weigh the cucumber and scallion. Slice them and keep them raw in a separate side dish.
instructions.zh: 小黃瓜與青蔥洗淨瀝乾秤重，切片後以生食另盛小碟。

instructions.en: Divide all measured olive oil and salt between the chicken rice and raw vegetable side, then serve together.
instructions.zh: 表列橄欖油與鹽全部分配到雞肉飯及生蔬菜配菜，一起上桌。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材均使用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一起調整。

label.en: Turkey and chopped-parsley wholewheat sandwich — standard recipe
label.zh: 巴西里火雞肉全麥三明治（標準配方）

notes.en: A parsley-and-olive-oil variation of the herb-turkey sandwich idea. No commercial pesto, basil, nuts or cheese are added separately; the bread's uncertain ingredient declarations remain unknown. Parsley stays chopped, not pureed into a paste. Whole-wheat French/Vienna bread is weighed as supplied. Raw cucumber, tomato, parsley and lemon juice share one FVNS weight basis; lemon-juice sugars count as free sugars.
notes.zh: 此香草火雞三明治構想採巴西里與橄欖油版本，不另外添加市售青醬、羅勒、堅果或起司；麵包原料中未能確認的項目仍保留未知。巴西里僅切碎，不打成糊；全麥法式／維也納麵包按供應狀態秤重。小黃瓜、番茄、巴西里及檸檬汁採同一生重 FVNS 基準，檸檬汁的糖計入游離糖。

instructions.en: Weigh and slice the prepared roasted turkey breast and wholewheat bread. Use the turkey cooled according to its storage instructions.
instructions.zh: 秤取已烤熟火雞胸與全麥麵包並切片，火雞肉依保存指示冷卻使用。

instructions.en: Wash, drain and weigh parsley, cucumber and tomato. Chop the parsley by hand and slice the cucumber and tomato; do not blend them.
instructions.zh: 巴西里、小黃瓜及番茄洗淨瀝乾秤重，巴西里手切碎，小黃瓜與番茄切片，不打成泥。

instructions.en: Mix the measured oil, lemon juice and salt with the chopped parsley. Use all of it in the turkey sandwich and the cucumber-tomato side salad.
instructions.zh: 表列油、檸檬汁與鹽拌入碎巴西里，全部用於火雞三明治及小黃瓜番茄配菜沙拉。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材均使用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一起調整。

label.en: Egg and baked-potato soup with a raw side salad — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞蛋烤馬鈴薯湯佐生菜沙拉（標準配方）

notes.en: A homemade defined soup-and-salad combination, not a Trader Joe's or other packaged-soup estimate. Soup uses baked potato flesh and skin, hard-boiled egg and retained drinking water, without milk or stock. Romaine, cucumber and tomato are served raw; starchy potato and egg do not count toward FVNS.
notes.zh: 此為自製定量湯與沙拉組合，不估算 Trader Joe's 或其他包裝湯品。湯採含皮烤馬鈴薯、水煮蛋及保留飲用水，不加奶或高湯。蘿蔓、小黃瓜及番茄生食；澱粉性馬鈴薯與蛋不計入 FVNS。

instructions.en: Weigh the baked potato with skin and peeled hard-boiled egg. Dice both; warm the potato chunks with the listed water without mashing or blending.
instructions.zh: 秤取含皮烤馬鈴薯與去殼水煮蛋，兩者都切丁；馬鈴薯塊加入表列水溫熱，不壓泥也不攪打。

instructions.en: Add the egg and, before seasoning, restore evaporated water to the listed potato, egg and water total. Stir in the measured salt.
instructions.zh: 加入蛋丁，調味前補回蒸發水至表列馬鈴薯、蛋與水的合計重量，再拌入表列鹽。

instructions.en: Wash, drain, weigh and cut the romaine, cucumber and tomato. Dress the raw salad with all measured olive oil and serve beside the soup.
instructions.zh: 蘿蔓、小黃瓜與番茄洗淨瀝乾、秤重切好，生菜沙拉拌入全部表列橄欖油，搭配湯食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材均使用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一起調整。

label.en: Grilled chicken rice bento with cabbage and carrot — standard recipe
label.zh: 炙烤雞胸高麗菜胡蘿蔔飯便當（標準配方）

notes.en: A plain grilled-chicken rice bento with two separately boiled, drained vegetable sides. It does not represent breaded or fried chicken, pickles, egg dishes, shop sauces or unweighed side-dish oil. Cabbage and carrot are weighed cooked; all seasoning is listed.
notes.zh: 此為原味炙烤雞胸飯便當，搭配兩道分別水煮瀝乾的蔬菜，不代表裹粉炸雞、醃菜、蛋料理、店家醬汁或未秤重配菜油。高麗菜與胡蘿蔔採熟重，調味全部明列。

instructions.en: Weigh and slice the prepared grilled skinless chicken breast. Portion the cooked white rice into a bowl or lunch container.
instructions.zh: 秤取已炙烤熟去皮雞胸並切片，熟白飯按所選份量盛入碗或餐盒。

instructions.en: Boil cabbage and carrot without salt, drain and weigh the edible cooked amounts. Arrange each vegetable as a separate side beside the chicken.
instructions.zh: 高麗菜與胡蘿蔔無鹽水煮瀝乾，秤可食熟重後分別作為雞肉旁的兩道配菜。

instructions.en: Divide all measured olive oil and salt between the chicken and vegetable sides and serve warm.
instructions.zh: 表列橄欖油與鹽全部分配到雞肉與蔬菜配菜，溫熱食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材均使用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一起調整。

label.en: Chicken, black turtle bean and bitter melon rice — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞肉黑菜豆苦瓜飯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses whole boiled black turtle beans (Phaseolus vulgaris), not fermented black soybeans or black-bean sauce. This source-matched variant contains roasted skinless chicken, boiled bitter-gourd fruit and rice. Bitter melon is seeded before cooking and edible cooked weighing; all qualifying beans and vegetables share a cooked-weight FVNS basis. No soy sauce or fermented seasoning is included.
notes.zh: 使用完整水煮黑菜豆（Phaseolus vulgaris），不是發酵黑大豆豆豉或豆豉醬。此來源對應版本含去皮烤雞胸、水煮苦瓜果肉與飯。苦瓜去籽後水煮，再秤可食熟重；合格豆類及蔬菜皆採同一熟重 FVNS 基準，不含醬油或發酵調味料。

instructions.en: Weigh the prepared roasted chicken, plain boiled black turtle beans and cooked white rice. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
instructions.zh: 秤取已烤熟雞胸、原味水煮黑菜豆與熟白飯，雞肉切成入口大小。

instructions.en: Remove bitter-melon seeds and inedible parts, boil without salt and drain well. Weigh the edible cooked fruit and combine with the chicken and beans.
instructions.zh: 苦瓜去籽及不可食部分，無鹽水煮並充分瀝乾，秤可食熟果肉後與雞肉、豆類混合。

instructions.en: Add all measured olive oil and salt, then serve the chicken-bean-bitter-melon mixture with the rice while warm.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部表列橄欖油與鹽，雞肉豆類苦瓜與白飯搭配，溫熱食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including all listed oil, salt, water and dressing ingredients.
instructions.zh: 所有食材均使用所選份量清單的克數，表列油、鹽、水與調味汁食材也一起調整。

label.en: Chicken and homemade hummus bread plate with boiled apple — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞肉自製鷹嘴豆泥麵包餐盤佐水煮蘋果（標準配方）

notes.en: A bread-plate version of the hummus-chicken wrap idea, using a measured homemade chickpea and toasted-sesame spread. The chickpeas are pureed, so their actual archived total sugars count as free sugars for this recipe only; ground sesame sugars do not. All qualifying chickpeas, sesame and apple use cooked weights. The apple stays in pieces, not applesauce. Bread is the specified whole-wheat French/Vienna source, not a tortilla. No lemon, raw garlic or extra sauce is added.
notes.zh: 此鷹嘴豆泥雞肉捲構想採麵包餐盤版本，使用定量自製鷹嘴豆與烘烤芝麻抹醬。鷹嘴豆打成泥，其歷史來源實際總糖僅於此配方計為游離糖；磨碎芝麻的糖不算。合格鷹嘴豆、芝麻與蘋果皆採熟重，蘋果保留果塊，不作蘋果泥。麵包採指定全麥法式／維也納來源，不是餅皮；不另外添加檸檬、生蒜或醬汁。

instructions.en: Weigh the plain boiled chickpeas and toasted sesame kernels. Grind the sesame, then blend it with the chickpeas and all listed water, oil and salt until smooth; scrape out all the spread.
instructions.zh: 秤取原味熟鷹嘴豆與烘烤芝麻仁；芝麻磨碎後與鷹嘴豆、全部表列水、油及鹽攪打成泥，完整刮出抹醬。

instructions.en: Peel and core apple pieces, boil without sugar, drain and weigh the cooked fruit. Keep the pieces intact rather than mashing them.
instructions.zh: 蘋果去皮去核切塊，不加糖水煮瀝乾後秤熟果肉，保留果塊不壓成泥。

instructions.en: Weigh the prepared roasted chicken and bread as supplied. Slice the chicken and serve it with all hummus, the bread and cooked apple pieces.
instructions.zh: 秤取已烤熟雞肉與供應狀態的麵包，雞肉切片後搭配全部鷹嘴豆泥、麵包及熟蘋果塊。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Greek yogurt, puffed rice and strawberry bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 希臘優格膨化米穀片草莓碗（標準配方）

notes.en: A crunchy-cereal variation of the yogurt-granola idea. It uses the specifically archived QUAKER Puffed Rice record, not granola, oat flakes or another current cereal product. Yogurt is plain nonfat Greek yogurt; strawberries stay raw and whole or sliced. Honey is weighed separately and its source sugars count as free sugars. No nuts are added separately; the cereal's uncertain ingredient declarations remain unknown.
notes.zh: 此優格穀片構想採酥脆米穀片版本，使用指定歷史 QUAKER 膨化米穀片紀錄，不是格蘭諾拉、燕麥片或其他現售穀片。優格為原味無脂希臘優格，草莓保持生鮮完整或切片；蜂蜜另秤，來源糖計為游離糖。不另外加堅果，穀片原料未能確認的項目仍保留未知。

instructions.en: Weigh the plain Greek yogurt into a bowl. Measure the puffed rice dry, directly from the package matching the named source type.
instructions.zh: 原味希臘優格秤入碗中，膨化米穀片依指定來源類型直接從包裝秤乾重。

instructions.en: Wash and drain the strawberries, remove leaves and inedible parts, then weigh and slice the raw berries.
instructions.zh: 草莓洗淨瀝乾，去葉及不可食部分後秤生重，再切片。

instructions.en: Top the yogurt with all weighed strawberries and puffed rice. Drizzle all measured honey and serve immediately to retain the crunch.
instructions.zh: 把全部秤好的草莓與膨化米穀片放上優格，淋入全部表列蜂蜜後立即食用，保留酥脆口感。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Chicken and Parmesan bread plate with romaine and banana — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞肉帕瑪森麵包餐盤佐蘿蔓與香蕉（標準配方）

notes.en: A defined Caesar-inspired bread plate with grilled chicken, hard Parmesan and a plain yogurt-lemon dressing. It is not an estimate for a tortilla wrap or prepared Caesar dressing with unknown oil, anchovy or egg amounts. Bread is weighed as supplied. Romaine, banana and lemon juice use raw weights; lemon sugars count as free sugars. No additional sauce ingredients are added.
notes.zh: 此凱薩風味構想採定量麵包餐盤，含炙烤雞肉、硬質帕瑪森及原味優格檸檬調味汁，不估算餅皮捲或油、鯷魚、蛋用量未知的預製凱薩醬。麵包按供應狀態秤重；蘿蔓、香蕉與檸檬汁採生重，檸檬糖計為游離糖。不另外加入其他醬料。

instructions.en: Weigh and slice the cooked grilled chicken and bread. Weigh a piece of hard Parmesan and grate it directly over the chicken.
instructions.zh: 秤取炙烤熟雞肉與麵包並切片，秤硬質帕瑪森起司塊後現刨在雞肉上。

instructions.en: Wash, drain and weigh the romaine. Peel and weigh the banana, keeping both raw beside the chicken and bread.
instructions.zh: 蘿蔓洗淨瀝乾秤重，香蕉去皮秤重，兩者都保持生鮮搭配雞肉與麵包。

instructions.en: Mix all listed yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil and salt. Use the entire dressing on the chicken and romaine.
instructions.zh: 全部表列優格、檸檬汁、橄欖油與鹽拌勻，完整用於雞肉及蘿蔓。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Black bean and Monterey cheese wholewheat bread plate — standard recipe
label.zh: 黑菜豆蒙特瑞起司全麥麵包餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: A clearly named bread-plate variation of the bean-cheese quesadilla idea, not a tortilla or fried quesadilla estimate. It uses whole boiled black turtle beans, plain Monterey cheese, boiled red pepper and sweetcorn with whole-wheat French/Vienna bread. All qualifying vegetables and beans use cooked weights. Keep beans whole; no salsa, extra frying fat or sweetened seasoning is added.
notes.zh: 此豆類起司 quesadilla 構想明確改為麵包餐盤，不估算餅皮或煎製 quesadilla。使用完整水煮黑菜豆、原味蒙特瑞起司、水煮紅甜椒及甜玉米，搭配全麥法式／維也納麵包。合格蔬菜與豆類皆採熟重；豆子保持完整，不另外加莎莎醬、煎油或含糖調味。

instructions.en: Weigh the plain boiled black beans, boiled drained red pepper and sweetcorn kernels. Warm these prepared ingredients without frying.
instructions.zh: 秤取原味熟黑菜豆、水煮瀝乾紅甜椒與甜玉米粒，將這些已熟食材溫熱，不煎炒。

instructions.en: Weigh the bread as supplied and slice the plain Monterey cheese. Arrange the cheese on the bread and the whole beans and vegetables alongside.
instructions.zh: 麵包按供應狀態秤重，原味蒙特瑞起司秤好切片，放上麵包，完整豆子與蔬菜另放旁邊。

instructions.en: Mix all measured olive oil and salt into the beans and vegetables. Serve with the cheese and bread while the filling is warm.
instructions.zh: 全部表列橄欖油與鹽拌入豆子及蔬菜，配料溫熱時搭配起司與麵包食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: White bean, mozzarella and vegetable bread plate — standard recipe
label.zh: 白菜豆莫札瑞拉蔬菜麵包餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: A wholewheat-bread variation of the bean-vegetable-cheese idea. It uses whole white beans, whole-milk mozzarella, cooked zucchini and cooked tomato pieces; this does not estimate a tortilla, ready-made salsa or fried quesadilla. All qualifying beans and vegetables are weighed cooked, and tomato stays in pieces rather than puree or concentrated paste.
notes.zh: 此豆類蔬菜起司構想採全麥麵包版本，使用完整白菜豆、全脂莫札瑞拉、熟櫛瓜與熟番茄塊，不估算餅皮、預製莎莎醬或煎製 quesadilla。合格豆類與蔬菜皆採熟重，番茄保留果塊，不做成泥或濃縮醬。

instructions.en: Weigh the plain cooked white beans, boiled drained zucchini and cooked tomato pieces. Warm them gently without reducing the tomato to paste.
instructions.zh: 秤取原味熟白菜豆、水煮瀝乾櫛瓜與熟番茄塊，輕柔溫熱，不將番茄熬成濃醬。

instructions.en: Weigh the wholewheat bread and plain whole-milk mozzarella as supplied. Slice the cheese and arrange with the bread.
instructions.zh: 全麥麵包與原味全脂莫札瑞拉按供應狀態秤重，起司切片搭配麵包。

instructions.en: Add all measured olive oil and salt to the bean-vegetable mixture. Serve it warm beside the cheese and bread.
instructions.zh: 豆類蔬菜拌入全部表列橄欖油與鹽，溫熱搭配起司與麵包。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Roasted chicken, avocado and romaine sandwich — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤雞肉酪梨蘿蔓三明治（標準配方）

notes.en: A sandwich variation of the chicken-salad wrap idea, using plain roasted skinless chicken breast and the specified wholewheat bread. It does not estimate seasoned rotisserie chicken, a tortilla, or dressing from a bagged salad kit. Avocado, romaine, cucumber and lemon juice share a raw-weight FVNS basis; lemon sugars count as free sugars. No mayonnaise or additional oil is added.
notes.zh: 此雞肉沙拉捲構想採三明治版本，使用原味去皮烤雞胸及指定全麥麵包，不估算調味旋轉烤雞、餅皮或袋裝沙拉包調味醬。酪梨、蘿蔓、小黃瓜及檸檬汁採同一生重 FVNS 基準，檸檬糖計為游離糖；不另外加美乃滋或油。

instructions.en: Weigh and slice the prepared roasted chicken breast and bread. Use chicken cooled according to its storage instructions.
instructions.zh: 秤取已烤熟雞胸與麵包並切片，雞肉依保存指示冷卻使用。

instructions.en: Peel and stone the avocado before weighing its flesh. Wash, drain and weigh romaine and cucumber; slice the avocado and cucumber without mashing.
instructions.zh: 酪梨去皮去核後秤果肉；蘿蔓與小黃瓜洗淨瀝乾秤重，酪梨與小黃瓜切片，不壓成泥。

instructions.en: Mix all listed lemon juice and salt, coat the raw filling, then layer it with the chicken in the bread. Serve any filling that does not fit alongside.
instructions.zh: 全部表列檸檬汁與鹽拌勻，拌入生鮮配料後，與雞肉一起夾入麵包；放不下的配料另盛搭配食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Garlic-yogurt grilled chicken rice bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 生蒜優格炙烤雞肉飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: A garlic-yogurt grilled-chicken variation of the shawarma bowl idea, not an estimate for a spiced shop marinade or shawarma meat. Garlic is raw and hand-chopped, not crushed into paste or cooked. Cucumber, tomato and garlic all use raw weights. Yogurt is plain nonfat Greek yogurt; no unlisted spice blend, sauce or oil is added.
notes.zh: 此 shawarma 飯碗構想採生蒜優格炙烤雞肉版本，不估算店家香料醃料或 shawarma 肉。大蒜生食、手工切碎，不壓成泥也不烹煮；小黃瓜、番茄與大蒜皆採生重。優格為原味無脂希臘優格，不另外加未列出的香料包、醬汁或油。

instructions.en: Weigh and slice the prepared grilled chicken breast. Portion the cooked white rice into a bowl.
instructions.zh: 秤取已炙烤熟雞胸並切片，熟白飯按所選份量盛碗。

instructions.en: Wash, drain and weigh cucumber and tomato. Peel and weigh the raw garlic, then finely chop it by hand without crushing or blending.
instructions.zh: 小黃瓜與番茄洗淨瀝乾秤重；生蒜去皮秤重後手工細切，不壓泥或攪打。

instructions.en: Stir the chopped garlic, all yogurt, oil and salt together. Serve this raw-garlic dressing and raw vegetables beside the warm chicken rice, without reheating the dressing.
instructions.zh: 碎生蒜與全部優格、油及鹽拌勻，連同生蔬菜搭配溫熱雞肉飯；調味汁不再加熱。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Homemade hummus with cooked vegetables and wholewheat bread — standard recipe
label.zh: 自製鷹嘴豆泥佐熟蔬菜全麥麵包（標準配方）

notes.en: A hummus-and-vegetable bread plate derived from the chickpea-meal idea, not fried falafel or pita. All chickpeas, toasted sesame, carrots and red pepper are weighed cooked. Only the chickpeas are pureed: their source total sugars become recipe-specific free sugars, while sesame sugars remain outside the free-sugar definition. Vegetables stay in pieces. No raw herb, lemon juice or additional sauce is added.
notes.zh: 此鷹嘴豆餐點構想採鷹嘴豆泥蔬菜麵包餐盤，不是炸 falafel 或皮塔餅。鷹嘴豆、烘烤芝麻、胡蘿蔔及紅甜椒皆採熟重；僅鷹嘴豆打成泥，其來源總糖改計此配方的游離糖，芝麻糖仍不屬於游離糖。蔬菜保留塊狀，不另外加入生香草、檸檬汁或醬汁。

instructions.en: Weigh the plain boiled chickpeas and toasted sesame kernels. Grind the sesame and blend it with the chickpeas and all listed water, olive oil and salt. Scrape out the full amount of hummus.
instructions.zh: 秤取原味熟鷹嘴豆及烘烤芝麻仁；芝麻磨碎後與鷹嘴豆、全部表列水、橄欖油及鹽攪打，完整刮出全部豆泥。

instructions.en: Boil carrot and red pepper without salt, drain and weigh the cooked edible pieces. Keep them whole or sliced, not blended.
instructions.zh: 胡蘿蔔與紅甜椒無鹽水煮瀝乾後秤可食熟重，保留完整或切片，不攪打。

instructions.en: Weigh the wholewheat bread as supplied. Serve the full hummus portion with the bread and cooked carrot and pepper pieces.
instructions.zh: 全麥麵包按供應狀態秤重，搭配全部豆泥與熟胡蘿蔔、紅甜椒塊。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Lean pork and shiitake wholewheat noodle soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 瘦豬肉香菇全麥麵湯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses cooked wholewheat pasta in a noodle-soup variation, not an unsupported udon nutrient record. Pork is the verified cooked-crumbles source made from 96%-lean/4%-fat raw ground pork; this ratio is not the cooked fat percentage. Shiitake and bok choy are plain cooked, drained ingredients. Listed retained drinking water, oil and salt are the broth; no stock, miso or soy sauce is estimated.
notes.zh: 此麵湯版本使用熟全麥義大利麵，不套用缺乏支持的烏龍麵營養資料。豬肉採已驗證的熟碎肉來源，其原料絞肉為 96% 瘦肉／4% 脂肪，此比例不代表熟肉脂肪百分比。香菇與青江菜為原味熟、瀝乾食材；表列保留飲用水、油及鹽即湯底，不估算高湯、味噌或醬油。

instructions.en: Weigh the prepared cooked pork crumbles and drained cooked wholewheat pasta. Remove any inedible mushroom stems, then weigh cooked shiitake and boiled drained bok choy.
instructions.zh: 秤取已熟豬碎肉與瀝乾熟全麥義大利麵；香菇去不可食硬蒂後秤熟重，另秤水煮瀝乾青江菜。

instructions.en: Warm pork, pasta, shiitake and bok choy with the listed water. Before seasoning, restore evaporated water to the total listed solid ingredients plus water.
instructions.zh: 豬肉、麵、香菇與青江菜加入表列水一起溫熱；調味前補回蒸發水至表列固體食材與水的合計重量。

instructions.en: Stir in all measured olive oil and salt. Serve the full soup without adding broth concentrate or extra sauce.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部表列橄欖油與鹽，整份湯一起食用，不另加高湯濃縮物或醬汁。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Egg, cucumber and tomato wholewheat pasta salad — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞蛋小黃瓜番茄全麥義大利麵沙拉（標準配方）

notes.en: A clearly named wholewheat-pasta version of the egg noodle-salad idea, not soba: the reviewed cooked soba source lacks fiber needed for complete scoring. Pasta is cooked and drained, egg is hard-boiled, and cucumber, tomato and lemon juice use raw weights. Lemon-juice sugars count as free sugars. No sesame dressing, soy sauce or additional oil is included.
notes.zh: 此雞蛋冷麵構想明確使用全麥義大利麵，不是蕎麥麵；已檢視的熟蕎麥麵來源缺少完整計分所需的纖維資料。麵煮熟瀝乾，蛋為水煮蛋，小黃瓜、番茄及檸檬汁採生重。檸檬汁糖計為游離糖，不含芝麻調味汁、醬油或額外油。

instructions.en: Weigh the drained cooked wholewheat pasta and peeled hard-boiled egg. Cool according to their storage instructions and cut the egg into wedges.
instructions.zh: 瀝乾熟全麥義大利麵與去殼水煮蛋秤重，依保存指示冷卻，蛋切塊。

instructions.en: Wash, drain and weigh the cucumber and tomato, then slice them and combine with the cooled pasta and egg.
instructions.zh: 小黃瓜與番茄洗淨瀝乾秤重後切片，與冷卻的麵及蛋混合。

instructions.en: Mix all listed lemon juice, olive oil and salt. Toss the salad with the entire dressing and serve cool.
instructions.zh: 全部表列檸檬汁、橄欖油與鹽拌勻，完整拌入沙拉後冷食。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Edamame, shiitake and spinach wholewheat noodle soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 毛豆香菇菠菜全麥麵湯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses prepared shelled edamame, cooked shiitake, boiled spinach and cooked wholewheat pasta, not soba or a ready-made Japanese broth. All qualifying soybeans and vegetables use cooked weights. Listed retained water, oil and salt are the complete soup seasoning; no kombu, miso, soy sauce or concentrated stock is added.
notes.zh: 使用熟去殼毛豆、熟香菇、水煮菠菜與熟全麥義大利麵，不是蕎麥麵或預製日式高湯。合格黃豆及蔬菜皆採熟重；表列保留水、油及鹽為完整湯底調味，不另加昆布、味噌、醬油或濃縮高湯。

instructions.en: Weigh the prepared shelled edamame and drained cooked wholewheat pasta. Weigh cooked shiitake without inedible stems and boiled drained spinach.
instructions.zh: 秤取熟去殼毛豆與瀝乾熟全麥義大利麵；熟香菇去不可食硬蒂後秤重，另秤水煮瀝乾菠菜。

instructions.en: Warm all weighed solid ingredients in the listed water. Before seasoning, restore evaporated water to the listed solids-plus-water total.
instructions.zh: 所有秤好的固體食材加入表列水溫熱，調味前補回蒸發水至表列固體食材與水的合計重量。

instructions.en: Stir in all measured olive oil and salt, then serve the whole soup while warm.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部表列橄欖油與鹽，整份湯溫熱食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Salmon rice bowl with honey and chopped raw garlic — standard recipe
label.zh: 鮭魚飯碗佐蜂蜜與碎生蒜（標準配方）

notes.en: A measured honey-garlic variation of the salmon-bowl idea, not bottled teriyaki sauce or a cooked glaze. Salmon uses the dry-heat-cooked farmed Atlantic source. Raw garlic stays chopped rather than pasted; cucumber, scallion, garlic and lemon juice share one raw FVNS weight basis. Honey and lemon sugars count as free sugars. No soy sauce, mirin or added oil is included.
notes.zh: 此鮭魚飯構想採定量蜂蜜生蒜調味版本，不是瓶裝照燒醬或煮製糖衣。鮭魚採乾熱煮熟養殖大西洋來源。生蒜維持切碎、不壓成泥；小黃瓜、青蔥、大蒜與檸檬汁採同一生重 FVNS 基準。蜂蜜與檸檬糖計為游離糖，不含醬油、味醂或額外油。

instructions.en: Remove bones and inedible parts from the prepared fully cooked salmon before weighing its edible portion. Weigh the plain cooked white rice, then portion both into a bowl.
instructions.zh: 已完全煮熟鮭魚先去骨及不可食部分，再秤可食重量；另秤原味熟白飯後一起盛碗。

instructions.en: Wash, drain and weigh cucumber and scallion. Peel and weigh the raw garlic, then hand-chop it without crushing or blending.
instructions.zh: 小黃瓜與青蔥洗淨瀝乾秤重；生蒜去皮秤重後手切碎，不壓泥或攪打。

instructions.en: Mix the chopped raw garlic with all honey, lemon juice and salt. Serve this unheated dressing and raw vegetables alongside the salmon rice.
instructions.zh: 碎生蒜與全部蜂蜜、檸檬汁及鹽拌勻，以未加熱調味汁及生蔬菜搭配鮭魚飯。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Whole-soybean, cauliflower and leek soup with rice — standard recipe
label.zh: 完整黃豆白花椰菜韭蔥湯佐飯（標準配方）

notes.en: A whole-bean version of the soy-and-vegetable soup idea, using fully boiled mature soybeans rather than tofu. Bean grams are hydrated cooked edible weights, not dry weights. Cauliflower and leek are boiled without salt and drained; all qualifying ingredients use cooked weights and remain in pieces. The soup uses retained drinking water with the listed oil and salt, not stock or miso. Preparation time starts with cooked beans, vegetables and rice.
notes.zh: 此豆類蔬菜湯構想採完整豆粒版本，使用已充分水煮的成熟黃豆，不是豆腐；豆類克數為吸水後可食熟重，不是乾重。白花椰菜與韭蔥未加鹽水煮瀝乾，合格食材皆採熟重、保持塊狀。湯底為保留飲用水與表列油鹽，不是高湯或味噌；準備時間從已有熟豆、熟蔬菜與飯起算。

instructions.en: Weigh the fully cooked mature soybeans, drained cooked cauliflower and leek, and cooked rice. Keep the rice separate for serving.
instructions.zh: 秤取充分煮熟的成熟黃豆、瀝乾熟白花椰菜與韭蔥，另秤熟白飯留作配飯。

instructions.en: Warm the beans, cauliflower and leek with the listed water. Before seasoning, restore evaporated water to the listed soup solids-plus-water total, excluding the separate rice.
instructions.zh: 黃豆、白花椰菜與韭蔥加入表列水溫熱；調味前補回蒸發水至表列湯料與水的合計重量，另盛白飯不計入湯重。

instructions.en: Stir all measured olive oil and salt into the soup. Serve the entire soup with the weighed rice.
instructions.zh: 全部表列橄欖油與鹽拌入湯中，整份湯搭配秤好的白飯食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: White bean, shiitake and turnip rice porridge — standard recipe
label.zh: 白菜豆香菇蕪菁粥（標準配方）

notes.en: This bean-and-mushroom porridge uses whole boiled white beans, not tofu. Cooked white rice is loosened with a measured amount of retained water; no raw-rice cooking-yield assumption is used. Shiitake and turnip are plain cooked and drained, and all qualifying ingredients use cooked weights. Keep beans and vegetables in pieces; no stock concentrate or blended vegetable puree is included.
notes.zh: 此豆類菇粥使用完整水煮白菜豆，不是豆腐。熟白飯加入定量保留水煮鬆，不採生米煮飯產量假設。香菇與蕪菁為原味熟、瀝乾食材，合格食材皆採熟重。豆類與蔬菜保持塊狀，不含濃縮高湯或攪打蔬菜泥。

instructions.en: Weigh the cooked rice, whole boiled white beans, cooked shiitake without inedible stems, and boiled drained turnip pieces.
instructions.zh: 秤取熟白飯、完整熟白菜豆、去不可食硬蒂的熟香菇及水煮瀝乾蕪菁塊。

instructions.en: Gently simmer the rice in the listed water to loosen the grains, then add the prepared beans and vegetables. Keep them whole or in pieces.
instructions.zh: 熟飯加入表列水輕煮至米粒鬆散，再加入已熟豆類與蔬菜，豆粒及蔬菜保持完整或塊狀。

instructions.en: Restore evaporated water to the total listed rice, beans, vegetables and water before adding all measured olive oil and salt. Serve warm.
instructions.zh: 加入全部表列橄欖油與鹽前，補回蒸發水至表列米飯、豆類、蔬菜與水的合計重量，溫熱食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Egg, whole-soybean and green pea rice porridge — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞蛋完整黃豆青豌豆粥（標準配方）

notes.en: A defined egg-and-whole-soybean porridge, not egg tofu or soft tofu. The egg is hard-boiled and peeled; mature soybeans and green peas are fully cooked and weighed hydrated, not dry. All qualifying beans and peas use cooked weights and stay whole. Cooked rice plus the listed retained water forms the porridge; preparation time starts with cooked ingredients.
notes.zh: 此定量粥使用雞蛋與完整黃豆，不是雞蛋豆腐或嫩豆腐。蛋為去殼水煮蛋，成熟黃豆與青豌豆皆充分煮熟，以吸水熟重秤量，不採乾重。合格豆類與豌豆皆採熟重並保持完整；熟飯與表列保留水組成粥體，準備時間從已有熟食材起算。

instructions.en: Weigh and chop the peeled hard-boiled egg. Weigh the cooked rice, fully boiled mature soybeans and boiled drained green peas.
instructions.zh: 去殼水煮蛋秤重切塊，另秤熟白飯、充分水煮的成熟黃豆及水煮瀝乾青豌豆。

instructions.en: Simmer the cooked rice with the listed water until the grains loosen. Add the prepared egg, whole soybeans and peas and warm through.
instructions.zh: 熟飯加入表列水輕煮至米粒鬆散，再加入已熟蛋、完整黃豆與豌豆溫熱。

instructions.en: Before seasoning, restore evaporated water to the listed egg, beans, peas, rice and water total. Add all measured oil and salt and serve.
instructions.zh: 調味前補回蒸發水至表列蛋、豆類、豌豆、飯及水的合計重量，再加入全部表列油鹽食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Edamame, bok choy and celery soup with rice — standard recipe
label.zh: 毛豆青江菜西洋芹湯佐飯（標準配方）

notes.en: A green-vegetable and whole-edamame soup, not a tofu soup. Shelled prepared edamame, boiled bok choy and boiled celery are weighed cooked and drained; all qualifying ingredients use the same cooked-weight basis. Celery is an explicit ingredient and avoidance tag. The rice is served separately; the soup liquid is the listed retained water, oil and salt.
notes.zh: 此綠蔬菜湯採完整毛豆，不是豆腐湯。熟去殼毛豆、水煮青江菜與西洋芹瀝乾秤熟重，合格食材採同一熟重基準。西洋芹為明列食材及避開標籤；白飯另盛，湯液為表列保留水、油及鹽。

instructions.en: Weigh prepared shelled edamame, boiled drained bok choy and celery, and cooked white rice. Set the rice aside.
instructions.zh: 秤取熟去殼毛豆、水煮瀝乾青江菜與西洋芹，另秤熟白飯留作配飯。

instructions.en: Warm edamame, bok choy and celery with the listed water. Before seasoning, restore any lost water to the listed soup solids-plus-water mass, excluding the rice.
instructions.zh: 毛豆、青江菜與西洋芹加入表列水溫熱；調味前補回流失水至表列湯料與水的合計重量，不包含另盛白飯。

instructions.en: Stir in all measured olive oil and salt. Serve the entire soup with the separately weighed rice.
instructions.zh: 全部表列橄欖油與鹽拌入湯中，整份湯搭配另秤白飯。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: White bean, spinach and leek bowl with toasted sesame — standard recipe
label.zh: 白菜豆菠菜韭蔥烘烤芝麻碗（標準配方）

notes.en: This warm bean-and-spinach bowl uses whole boiled white beans, cooked spinach, leek and toasted sesame kernels; it contains no separately added tofu or miso. All qualifying ingredients, including toasted sesame, use cooked weights. Sesame stays whole rather than forming an unspecified sauce. The listed oil and salt are all added seasoning; no rice or bread is included.
notes.zh: 此溫熱豆類菠菜碗使用完整水煮白菜豆、熟菠菜、韭蔥及烘烤芝麻仁，不另外添加豆腐或味噌。包含烘烤芝麻在內的合格食材皆採熟重；芝麻保持顆粒，不變成配方未知的醬。表列油鹽為全部額外調味，不含飯或麵包。

instructions.en: Weigh the whole boiled white beans, boiled drained spinach and leek. Gently warm these prepared ingredients.
instructions.zh: 秤取完整熟白菜豆、水煮瀝乾菠菜與韭蔥，將這些已熟食材輕柔溫熱。

instructions.en: Arrange the beans and vegetables in a bowl, keeping the beans whole and the vegetables in pieces.
instructions.zh: 豆類及蔬菜一起盛碗，豆粒保持完整，蔬菜保留塊狀。

instructions.en: Mix in all measured olive oil and salt, then sprinkle the full weighed amount of toasted unsalted sesame kernels over the bowl.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部表列橄欖油與鹽，再撒上完整秤好的未加鹽烘烤芝麻仁。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Chickpea, broccoli and cauliflower wholewheat noodles — standard recipe
label.zh: 鷹嘴豆綠白花椰菜全麥麵（標準配方）

notes.en: A whole-chickpea and vegetable noodle version using the reviewed cooked wholewheat pasta source, not tofu or udon. Chickpeas remain whole and retain their intact-food free-sugar basis; they are not hummus or puree. Broccoli and cauliflower are boiled without salt and drained. All qualifying beans and vegetables use cooked weights; no prepared noodle sauce is included.
notes.zh: 此完整鷹嘴豆蔬菜麵版本使用已審查的熟全麥義大利麵來源，不是豆腐或烏龍麵。鷹嘴豆保持完整，沿用完整食材的游離糖依據，不是豆泥。綠、白花椰菜皆未加鹽水煮瀝乾，合格豆類與蔬菜採熟重，不含預製拌麵醬。

instructions.en: Weigh the drained cooked wholewheat pasta and whole boiled chickpeas. Weigh boiled drained broccoli and cauliflower.
instructions.zh: 秤取瀝乾熟全麥義大利麵與完整熟鷹嘴豆，另秤水煮瀝乾綠、白花椰菜。

instructions.en: Warm the prepared pasta, chickpeas and vegetables gently, then combine in a bowl without mashing the chickpeas.
instructions.zh: 已熟麵、鷹嘴豆與蔬菜輕柔溫熱後盛碗混合，不壓碎鷹嘴豆。

instructions.en: Toss with all measured olive oil and salt. Serve warm without extra noodle sauce or frying.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部表列橄欖油與鹽後溫熱食用，不另加拌麵醬或煎炒。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Spicy pork, whole-soybean and eggplant rice bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 辣味豬肉完整黃豆茄子飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: A pork-and-whole-soybean rice variation, not mapo tofu or a fermented-bean sauce estimate. Pork uses the cooked-crumbles source from 96%-lean/4%-fat raw ground pork; cooked fat is calculated from the source, not that raw ratio. Soybeans and eggplant are fully boiled, drained and weighed cooked. Pure finely ground cayenne powder supplies the measured heat: its sugars count as free sugars and the powder is excluded from FVNS. No tofu, doubanjiang or extra sauce is added.
notes.zh: 此豬肉完整黃豆飯版本不是麻婆豆腐或發酵豆醬估算。豬肉採原料為 96% 瘦肉／4% 脂肪絞肉的熟碎肉來源，熟肉脂肪依來源計算，不套用生肉比例。黃豆與茄子充分水煮、瀝乾秤熟重。純細磨卡宴辣椒粉提供定量辣味，其糖計為游離糖，粉末不納入 FVNS；不另外加豆腐、豆瓣醬或其他醬。

instructions.en: Weigh the prepared cooked pork crumbles, fully boiled mature soybeans, boiled drained eggplant pieces and cooked rice.
instructions.zh: 秤取已熟豬碎肉、充分水煮成熟黃豆、水煮瀝乾茄子塊及熟白飯。

instructions.en: Gently warm the pork, whole soybeans and eggplant. Keep the eggplant in pieces and arrange the mixture over the rice.
instructions.zh: 豬肉、完整黃豆與茄子輕柔溫熱，茄子保持塊狀，混合後鋪在飯上。

instructions.en: Mix all measured cayenne powder with the listed olive oil and salt, then stir the full seasoning into the pork-and-bean mixture.
instructions.zh: 表列卡宴辣椒粉、橄欖油與鹽全部拌勻，再完整拌入豬肉豆類配料。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Spicy edamame, cabbage and carrot rice bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 辣味毛豆高麗菜胡蘿蔔飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses whole prepared edamame with boiled cabbage and carrot. This is a spicy bean-and-cabbage rice version, not tofu or fermented kimchi, and it does not borrow a kimchi sodium or sugar estimate. All qualifying beans and vegetables use cooked weights. The only added heat is pure finely ground cayenne powder, whose actual source sugars count as free sugars; powder contributes no FVNS credit.
notes.zh: 使用完整熟毛豆、水煮高麗菜與胡蘿蔔。此為辣味豆類高麗菜飯，不是豆腐或發酵泡菜，不借用泡菜的鈉或糖估算。合格豆類與蔬菜皆採熟重；唯一額外辣味為純細磨卡宴辣椒粉，其來源實際糖計為游離糖，粉末不提供 FVNS 分數。

instructions.en: Weigh the prepared shelled edamame, cooked rice, boiled drained cabbage and carrot.
instructions.zh: 秤取熟去殼毛豆、熟白飯、水煮瀝乾高麗菜及胡蘿蔔。

instructions.en: Warm the whole edamame and vegetable pieces, then arrange them over the rice without fermenting or pickling.
instructions.zh: 完整毛豆與蔬菜塊溫熱後放在飯上，不進行發酵或醃漬。

instructions.en: Combine all measured cayenne powder, olive oil and salt. Mix the full seasoning through the beans and vegetables and serve warm.
instructions.zh: 全部表列卡宴辣椒粉、橄欖油與鹽拌勻，完整拌入豆類及蔬菜後溫熱食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Spicy grilled chicken, cabbage and sweet potato bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 辣味炙烤雞肉高麗菜地瓜碗（標準配方）

notes.en: A spicy chicken-and-vegetable variation with plain grilled skinless chicken, baked sweet-potato flesh, boiled cabbage and onion. It is not an estimate for dak-galbi sauce, rice cakes or a shop's stir-frying oil. Only cabbage and onion contribute cooked-weight FVNS; sweet potato is excluded under the model's tuber rule. Finely ground cayenne sugars count as free sugars and the powder receives no FVNS credit.
notes.zh: 此辣味雞肉蔬菜版本含原味去皮炙烤雞肉、去皮烤地瓜果肉、水煮高麗菜及洋蔥，不估算 dak-galbi 醬、年糕或店家炒油。僅高麗菜與洋蔥提供熟重 FVNS，地瓜依模型塊莖規則排除；細磨卡宴辣椒粉的糖計為游離糖，粉末不獲 FVNS 加分。

instructions.en: Remove skin and inedible parts from the baked sweet potato before weighing the flesh. Weigh the cooked grilled chicken, boiled drained cabbage and onion.
instructions.zh: 烤地瓜先去皮及不可食部分，再秤果肉；另秤已炙烤熟雞肉、水煮瀝乾高麗菜與洋蔥。

instructions.en: Cut chicken and sweet potato into pieces. Warm them with the prepared cabbage and onion without extra frying oil.
instructions.zh: 雞肉與地瓜切塊，與已熟高麗菜及洋蔥一起溫熱，不另加炒油。

instructions.en: Mix all listed cayenne powder with the measured olive oil and salt, coat all ingredients, and serve the full bowl warm.
instructions.zh: 全部表列卡宴辣椒粉、橄欖油與鹽拌勻，完整拌入所有食材後整碗溫熱食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Chunky chicken, potato, pea and cauliflower stew — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞肉馬鈴薯青豌豆白花椰菜燉湯（標準配方）

notes.en: A defined chicken-and-vegetable stew from the curry-meal idea, without an unspecified curry roux, spice blend or sauce. Chicken is plain grilled breast; potato is the baked flesh-and-skin source, not a boiled-potato value. Peas and cauliflower are boiled without salt and drained. All qualifying vegetables use cooked weights and remain intact; the listed retained water, oil and salt form the stew liquid.
notes.zh: 此咖哩餐構想採定量雞肉蔬菜燉湯，不使用成分未知的咖哩塊、混合香料或醬。雞肉為原味炙烤雞胸，馬鈴薯採含皮烤熟來源，不套用水煮值；青豌豆與白花椰菜未加鹽水煮瀝乾。合格蔬菜皆採熟重並保留完整，表列保留水、油與鹽組成燉湯液體。

instructions.en: Weigh the prepared grilled chicken, baked potato with skin, boiled drained peas and cauliflower. Cut chicken and potato into chunks.
instructions.zh: 秤取已炙烤熟雞肉、含皮烤馬鈴薯、水煮瀝乾青豌豆及白花椰菜，雞肉與馬鈴薯切塊。

instructions.en: Warm all chunks and vegetables with the listed water without blending or mashing. Restore evaporated water to the listed solids-plus-water total before seasoning.
instructions.zh: 所有肉塊、薯塊與蔬菜加入表列水溫熱，不攪打或壓泥；調味前補回蒸發水至表列固體食材與水的合計重量。

instructions.en: Add all measured olive oil and salt. Serve the complete chunky stew without adding curry sauce or stock concentrate.
instructions.zh: 加入全部表列橄欖油與鹽，整份塊狀燉湯一起食用，不另加咖哩醬或濃縮高湯。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Salmon, leek and green pea rice porridge — standard recipe
label.zh: 鮭魚韭蔥青豌豆粥（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses fully dry-heat-cooked farmed Atlantic salmon with cooked rice, boiled leek and green peas. This is a measured salmon-vegetable porridge, not a miso-broth estimate. The rice starts cooked; retained water is measured rather than inferred from raw-rice yield. All qualifying vegetables use cooked weights and stay in pieces; no additional stock or miso is added.
notes.zh: 使用乾熱完全煮熟的養殖大西洋鮭魚、熟飯、水煮韭蔥與青豌豆。此為定量鮭魚蔬菜粥，不估算味噌湯底。米飯從已熟狀態開始，保留水以秤量控制，不從生米產量推估；合格蔬菜皆採熟重、保持塊狀，不另外加高湯或味噌。

instructions.en: Remove bones and inedible parts from the fully cooked salmon before weighing and flaking it. Weigh cooked rice, boiled drained leek and peas.
instructions.zh: 已完全煮熟鮭魚先去骨及不可食部分，再秤重撥成塊；另秤熟飯、水煮瀝乾韭蔥及豌豆。

instructions.en: Simmer the cooked rice in the listed water until loosened. Add the prepared salmon, leek and peas and warm gently, keeping the vegetables intact.
instructions.zh: 熟飯加入表列水輕煮至鬆散，再加入已熟鮭魚、韭蔥及豌豆輕柔溫熱，蔬菜保持完整。

instructions.en: Before adding all measured oil and salt, restore evaporated water to the listed fish, rice, vegetables and water total. Serve the whole porridge.
instructions.zh: 加入全部表列油鹽前，補回蒸發水至表列魚、飯、蔬菜及水的合計重量，整份粥一起食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Baked cod, green pea and turnip rice plate — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤鱈魚青豌豆蕪菁飯餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: A plain cod-and-vegetable rice plate using dry-heat-cooked Atlantic cod, boiled green peas and turnip, with measured toasted sesame. It is not a miso-glazed fish or marinade estimate. All qualifying peas, turnip and sesame use cooked weights; turnip is an eligible root vegetable, not a potato substitute in the model. The listed oil and salt are all added seasoning.
notes.zh: 此原味鱈魚蔬菜飯餐盤使用乾熱煮熟大西洋鱈魚、水煮青豌豆與蕪菁，搭配定量烘烤芝麻，不估算味噌魚或醃料。合格豌豆、蕪菁及芝麻皆採熟重；蕪菁為合格根菜，在模型中不當成馬鈴薯處理。表列油鹽為全部額外調味。

instructions.en: Remove bones and inedible parts from the prepared baked cod before weighing it. Weigh the cooked white rice.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟鱈魚先去骨及不可食部分再秤重，另秤熟白飯。

instructions.en: Weigh boiled drained green peas and turnip pieces. Warm the prepared ingredients and arrange with the cod and rice.
instructions.zh: 秤取水煮瀝乾青豌豆及蕪菁塊，將已熟食材溫熱後與鱈魚、飯一起盛盤。

instructions.en: Add all measured olive oil and salt, then sprinkle the full weighed amount of toasted sesame kernels over the plate.
instructions.zh: 加入全部表列橄欖油與鹽，再把完整秤好的烘烤芝麻仁撒在餐盤上。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Whole-soybean, zucchini and green bean soup with rice — standard recipe
label.zh: 完整黃豆櫛瓜四季豆湯佐飯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses hydrated whole mature soybeans, boiled zucchini with skin and boiled green snap beans; all qualifying ingredients use cooked drained weights. This is a whole-bean soup in measured seasoned water, not tofu or miso soup. Rice is served separately. Assembly time starts with prepared beans, vegetables and rice; it does not include cooking dry soybeans.
notes.zh: 使用已吸水煮熟的完整成熟黃豆、帶皮水煮櫛瓜與水煮四季豆，所有合格食材皆採熟後瀝乾重量。這是以定量水與調味料組成的完整豆粒湯，不估算豆腐或味噌湯；飯另盛。組裝時間從備妥熟豆、蔬菜及飯起算，不包含乾黃豆烹煮時間。

instructions.en: Weigh the cooked whole soybeans, drained boiled zucchini and green beans. Weigh the cooked rice separately.
instructions.zh: 秤取完整熟黃豆、水煮瀝乾櫛瓜與四季豆，另秤熟白飯。

instructions.en: Warm the beans and vegetables in the listed water. Before seasoning, restore evaporated water until the soup weighs the selected amounts of beans, vegetables and water combined; exclude the separate rice.
instructions.zh: 把豆與蔬菜加入表列水中溫熱。調味前補回蒸發水分，讓湯總重等於所選豆、蔬菜與水的合計重量，不含另盛的飯。

instructions.en: Stir in all measured olive oil and salt. Serve the complete soup beside the rice, keeping the beans whole.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部定量橄欖油與鹽，保留完整豆粒，將整份湯與飯分別盛裝。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Boiled egg, spinach and sweetcorn egg-noodle soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 水煮蛋菠菜玉米蛋麵湯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses peeled hard-boiled egg, cooked enriched egg noodles, boiled spinach and boiled sweetcorn kernels. The egg remains in pieces; this is not an estimate for egg-drop soup or dumplings. All qualifying spinach and corn use cooked weights. The liquid is measured water with the listed oil and salt, not an unspecified broth.
notes.zh: 使用去殼水煮全蛋、煮熟的營養強化蛋麵、水煮菠菜及玉米粒。雞蛋保留切塊形式，不估算蛋花湯或餃子；合格菠菜與玉米均採熟重。湯液為定量水加表列油鹽，不使用成分未明的高湯。

instructions.en: Peel and weigh the hard-boiled egg, then cut into pieces. Weigh cooked drained egg noodles, spinach and sweetcorn kernels.
instructions.zh: 水煮蛋去殼秤重後切塊，另秤熟後瀝乾的蛋麵、菠菜及玉米粒。

instructions.en: Warm the weighed egg, noodles and vegetables in the listed water. Before seasoning, add water back to restore their combined selected weight plus the listed water.
instructions.zh: 將秤好的雞蛋、麵及蔬菜加入表列水中溫熱，調味前補水恢復至這些食材所選重量與表列水量的總和。

instructions.en: Add all measured olive oil and salt. Serve all solids and liquid together without blending the egg or corn.
instructions.zh: 加入全部定量橄欖油與鹽，固形物與湯液全部盛出，不把雞蛋或玉米打碎成泥。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Garlic chicken, whole-soybean and cabbage rice bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 蒜香雞肉完整黃豆高麗菜飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses plain grilled skinless chicken breast, whole boiled mature soybeans and boiled cabbage. The garlic comes from the specifically sourced plain garlic powder, not a sweetened soy-garlic sauce. Its actual total sugars are counted as free sugars and the powder is excluded from FVNS. Soybeans and cabbage use cooked drained weights; no soy sauce or frying oil is implied.
notes.zh: 使用原味炙烤去皮雞胸肉、完整水煮成熟黃豆與水煮高麗菜。蒜味來自指定來源的原味蒜粉，不是加糖醬油蒜醬；蒜粉實際總糖計為游離糖，粉末不計入 FVNS。黃豆與高麗菜採熟後瀝乾重量，不暗加醬油或煎炒油。

instructions.en: Weigh the prepared grilled chicken after removing any inedible parts. Weigh cooked rice, whole boiled soybeans and drained boiled cabbage.
instructions.zh: 已炙烤熟雞肉先去除不可食部分再秤重，另秤熟飯、完整水煮黃豆與瀝乾水煮高麗菜。

instructions.en: Arrange the warm prepared chicken, soybeans and cabbage over the rice. Keep the soybean kernels whole.
instructions.zh: 將已溫熱備妥的雞肉、黃豆及高麗菜放在飯上，保留完整豆粒。

instructions.en: Mix the weighed plain garlic powder with all listed olive oil and salt, then distribute the entire seasoning over the bowl.
instructions.zh: 將秤好的原味蒜粉與全部表列橄欖油、鹽混合，再把整份調味料均勻拌入飯碗。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: White bean, shiitake and leek wholewheat noodle soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 白菜豆香菇韭蔥全麥麵湯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses whole boiled white beans, cooked shiitake, boiled leek bulb and lower leaves, and cooked wholewheat pasta. The visible formulation is a bean-and-mushroom noodle soup, not tofu, wheat udon or miso broth. All qualifying ingredients use cooked weights; the beans remain whole rather than puréed.
notes.zh: 使用完整水煮白菜豆、熟香菇、水煮韭蔥莖基及下段葉，主食為熟全麥義大利麵。實際配方為豆類香菇麵湯，不估算豆腐、烏龍麵或味噌高湯；所有合格食材採熟重，豆粒保持完整，不打成泥。

instructions.en: Weigh cooked drained wholewheat pasta and whole white beans. Weigh prepared cooked shiitake and boiled drained edible leek pieces.
instructions.zh: 秤取熟後瀝乾全麥義大利麵及完整白菜豆，另秤熟香菇與水煮瀝乾的可食韭蔥段。

instructions.en: Warm the noodles, beans and vegetables in the listed water. Before adding seasoning, replace evaporation so the pot contents equal their selected weights plus the listed water.
instructions.zh: 把麵、豆及蔬菜加入表列水中溫熱，調味前補回蒸發水分，使鍋中內容總重等於這些食材所選重量加表列水量。

instructions.en: Stir in all measured olive oil and salt. Serve the whole beans, vegetables, noodles and liquid together.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部定量橄欖油與鹽，完整豆粒、蔬菜、麵與湯液一起全部盛出。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Egg, sweetcorn and celery soup with wholewheat bread — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞蛋玉米西洋芹湯佐全麥麵包（標準配方）

notes.en: A measured soup of hard-boiled egg pieces, boiled sweetcorn and celery, with the archived wholewheat French/Vienna-style bread served as supplied. It does not use a canned-soup label or assume toasted bread. Bread composition uncertainties stay visible in its source and avoidance checks. Qualifying corn and celery use cooked weights; the soup is not blended.
notes.zh: 以水煮蛋塊、水煮玉米與西洋芹組成定量湯品，搭配歷史資料所指的全麥法式／維也納式麵包原樣食用。不引用罐頭湯標示，也不假設已烘烤成吐司；麵包配方不確定性仍保留於來源與避食檢查。合格玉米及西洋芹採熟重，湯不攪打成泥。

instructions.en: Peel and weigh the hard-boiled egg, then cut it into pieces. Weigh boiled drained sweetcorn and celery; set aside the weighed bread.
instructions.zh: 水煮蛋去殼秤重後切塊，另秤水煮瀝乾玉米及西洋芹，秤好的麵包另放。

instructions.en: Warm the egg, corn and celery in the listed water. Before seasoning, restore the combined selected weight of these soup solids and water, excluding the bread.
instructions.zh: 將蛋、玉米與西洋芹加入表列水中溫熱；調味前補水恢復至這些湯料與表列水量的合計所選重量，不含麵包。

instructions.en: Add all measured olive oil and salt to the soup. Serve all soup contents with the bread alongside, without toasting or extra toppings.
instructions.zh: 將全部定量橄欖油與鹽加入湯中，整份湯搭配旁邊的麵包，不另烘烤或增加抹醬配料。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Scallion egg, tomato and cucumber rice bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 蔥花雞蛋番茄小黃瓜飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses peeled hard-boiled egg over cooked rice, with raw tomato, unpeeled cucumber and spring-onion tops and bulb. All qualifying vegetables use raw edible weights and are added after heating the rice; this version contains no tofu or fried egg. Chop the vegetables without blending them into a sauce or purée.
notes.zh: 使用去殼水煮全蛋與熟白飯，搭配生番茄、帶皮小黃瓜及青蔥蔥白與綠葉。所有合格蔬菜採可食生重，於飯加熱後加入；此版本未加入豆腐或煎蛋。蔬菜切塊或切碎，不打成醬或泥。

instructions.en: Peel and weigh the prepared hard-boiled egg. Weigh the cooked rice and warm only the egg and rice as needed.
instructions.zh: 已水煮熟雞蛋去殼後秤重，另秤熟白飯，依需要僅將蛋與飯溫熱。

instructions.en: Wash and trim the tomato, unpeeled cucumber and both edible parts of the scallion. Weigh them raw, then chop and add to the rice and egg.
instructions.zh: 清洗並修整番茄、帶皮小黃瓜及青蔥的可食蔥白與綠葉，採生重秤好再切塊或切碎，加入飯與雞蛋。

instructions.en: Dress with all measured olive oil and salt. Keep the vegetables raw and serve without adding an unlisted sauce.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部定量橄欖油與鹽，保留蔬菜生食狀態，不另外加入未列出的醬料。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Lentil, carrot and red-pepper wholewheat noodle box — standard recipe
label.zh: 扁豆胡蘿蔔紅椒全麥冷麵盒（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses cooked lentils, wholewheat pasta, boiled carrots and red sweet pepper, with toasted sesame kernels. This is a cold noodle-box formulation, not an estimate for buckwheat soba or tofu. All qualifying lentils, vegetables and sesame use cooked weights; cooling does not convert their preparation state to raw. Keep lentils whole.
notes.zh: 使用熟扁豆、全麥義大利麵、水煮胡蘿蔔與紅甜椒，搭配烘烤芝麻仁。這是冷麵盒配方，不估算蕎麥麵或豆腐；合格扁豆、蔬菜及芝麻皆採熟重，冷卻不代表改採生食來源。保留完整扁豆粒。

instructions.en: Use prepared chilled, cooked lentils and wholewheat pasta. Weigh each after draining, keeping the lentils whole.
instructions.zh: 使用已煮熟並冷藏備妥的扁豆及全麥義大利麵，瀝乾後分別秤重，保留完整扁豆粒。

instructions.en: Weigh chilled boiled carrot pieces and red sweet pepper. Arrange them in the box beside the noodles and lentils.
instructions.zh: 秤取已冷藏的水煮胡蘿蔔塊與紅甜椒，與麵及扁豆一起放入餐盒。

instructions.en: Mix in all measured olive oil and salt, then add the full weighed amount of toasted sesame kernels. Keep chilled until serving.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部定量橄欖油與鹽，再加入全部秤好的烘烤芝麻仁，食用前維持冷藏。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Chicken, turnip and leek rice soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞肉蕪菁韭蔥飯湯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses roasted skinless chicken breast, cooked rice, boiled turnip and leek. This plain formulation contains no ginger or unlisted stock. All qualifying turnip and leek use cooked weights; rice grains are kept in a measured soup rather than cooked down to porridge. Assembly starts with prepared cooked ingredients.
notes.zh: 使用去皮烤雞胸肉、熟白飯、水煮蕪菁與韭蔥。此原味配方未加入薑或未列出的高湯。所有合格蕪菁與韭蔥採熟重，米粒加入定量湯液中，不繼續熬成粥；組裝從備妥熟食材起算。

instructions.en: Weigh prepared roasted chicken after removing inedible parts, then slice it. Weigh cooked rice and boiled drained turnip and edible leek pieces.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟雞肉去除不可食部分後秤重切片，另秤熟飯、水煮瀝乾蕪菁與可食韭蔥段。

instructions.en: Warm the chicken, rice and vegetables in the listed water without reducing to porridge. Before seasoning, restore their combined selected weight plus the listed water.
instructions.zh: 把雞肉、飯與蔬菜加入表列水中溫熱，不熬煮成粥；調味前補水恢復至這些食材所選重量與表列水量的總和。

instructions.en: Stir in all measured olive oil and salt. Serve the entire rice soup, including all solids and liquid.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部定量橄欖油與鹽，整份飯湯全部盛出，包含所有固形食材與湯液。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Chicken, cauliflower and pea egg-noodle soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞肉白花椰菜青豌豆蛋麵湯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses grilled skinless chicken breast, enriched egg noodles, boiled cauliflower and whole green peas. All qualifying cauliflower and peas use cooked drained weights. This plain formulation contains no ginger, unlisted stock or sauce. The soup liquid is the measured retained water with the listed oil and salt.
notes.zh: 使用去皮炙烤雞胸肉、營養強化蛋麵、水煮白花椰菜及完整青豌豆。所有合格白花椰菜與青豌豆採熟後瀝乾重量。此原味配方未加入薑、未列出的高湯或醬汁；湯液為定量保留的水與表列油鹽。

instructions.en: Remove inedible parts before weighing the prepared grilled chicken. Weigh cooked drained egg noodles, boiled cauliflower and whole green peas.
instructions.zh: 已炙烤熟雞肉去除不可食部分後秤重，另秤熟後瀝乾蛋麵、水煮白花椰菜及完整青豌豆。

instructions.en: Warm the chicken, noodles and vegetables in the listed water. Before adding seasoning, restore the combined selected weight of those solids plus the listed water.
instructions.zh: 把雞肉、麵與蔬菜加入表列水中溫熱，調味前補水恢復至這些固形食材所選重量與表列水量的總和。

instructions.en: Stir all measured olive oil and salt through the soup. Serve the complete portion without discarding liquid.
instructions.zh: 把全部定量橄欖油與鹽拌勻入湯，整份盛出，不丟棄湯液。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Sesame-garlic chicken, shiitake and green bean rice plate — standard recipe
label.zh: 芝麻蒜香雞肉香菇四季豆飯餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: A plain grilled-chicken plate with cooked shiitake, green beans and toasted sesame, seasoned with the sourced garlic powder. It does not estimate three-cup chicken, sesame oil, rice wine, basil or a soy-sauce reduction. Qualifying mushrooms, green beans and sesame use cooked weights; the garlic powder contributes its actual derived free sugars and no FVNS.
notes.zh: 此餐盤採原味炙烤雞肉、熟香菇、四季豆及烘烤芝麻，使用指定來源的蒜粉調味。不估算三杯雞、麻油、米酒、羅勒或收乾醬油汁。合格香菇、四季豆及芝麻皆採熟重；蒜粉計入實際推導的游離糖，但不計入 FVNS。

instructions.en: Weigh the prepared grilled chicken after removing inedible parts. Weigh cooked rice, cooked shiitake and boiled drained green beans.
instructions.zh: 已炙烤熟雞肉去除不可食部分後秤重，另秤熟飯、熟香菇與水煮瀝乾四季豆。

instructions.en: Arrange the warm chicken, mushrooms and green beans with the rice. Keep the prepared vegetables in pieces.
instructions.zh: 將已溫熱的雞肉、香菇與四季豆搭配白飯盛盤，蔬菜保留塊狀。

instructions.en: Mix the measured plain garlic powder, olive oil and salt into the food; scatter all weighed toasted sesame kernels on top.
instructions.zh: 將定量原味蒜粉、橄欖油與鹽拌入食材，再撒上全部秤好的烘烤芝麻仁。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Spicy shrimp, whole-soybean and napa cabbage soup with rice — standard recipe
label.zh: 辣味蝦仁完整黃豆白菜湯佐飯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses moist-heat-cooked shrimp, hydrated whole mature soybeans and boiled napa cabbage, with rice separately. The archived shrimp contains 947 mg sodium per 100 g; that source value is retained, and no salt is added. This is not an estimate for soft tofu or restaurant broth. Plain cayenne and garlic powders follow their documented free-sugar/FVNS rules; qualifying soybeans and cabbage use cooked weights.
notes.zh: 使用濕熱煮熟蝦仁、已吸水煮熟的完整成熟黃豆與水煮白菜，飯另外盛。歷史蝦仁來源每 100 克含鈉 947 毫克，此值完整保留，配方不再加鹽；不估算嫩豆腐或餐廳高湯。原味卡宴辣椒粉與蒜粉依各自的游離糖／FVNS 規則計算，合格黃豆及白菜採熟重。

instructions.en: Remove shells and inedible parts from the prepared cooked shrimp before weighing. Weigh cooked whole soybeans, drained boiled napa cabbage and the separate cooked rice.
instructions.zh: 已煮熟蝦先去殼及不可食部分再秤重，另秤完整熟黃豆、水煮瀝乾白菜，以及另外盛裝的熟飯。

instructions.en: Warm the shrimp, soybeans and cabbage in the listed water. Before seasoning, restore their combined selected weight plus the water, excluding the separate rice.
instructions.zh: 將蝦仁、黃豆及白菜加入表列水中溫熱；調味前補水恢復至這些食材所選重量加表列水量，不含另盛的飯。

instructions.en: Stir in all weighed plain cayenne powder, garlic powder and olive oil. Add no salt; serve the entire soup beside the rice.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部秤好的原味卡宴辣椒粉、蒜粉及橄欖油，不另外加鹽，整份湯搭配另盛白飯。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Whole-soybean, cabbage and shiitake rice bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 完整黃豆高麗菜香菇飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses whole boiled mature soybeans, boiled cabbage and cooked shiitake over rice. All qualifying whole beans and vegetables use cooked weights. The listed oil and salt are the full added seasoning; no ginger or tofu is included. This formulation does not borrow tofu nutrient values or infer its bean fraction.
notes.zh: 使用完整水煮成熟黃豆、水煮高麗菜及熟香菇搭配飯。所有合格完整豆粒與蔬菜採熟重。表列油鹽為全部額外調味，未加入薑或豆腐；此配方不借用豆腐營養值或推測其黃豆比例。

instructions.en: Weigh the prepared whole boiled soybeans, drained boiled cabbage and cooked shiitake. Weigh the cooked rice separately.
instructions.zh: 秤取已備妥的完整水煮黃豆、水煮瀝乾高麗菜與熟香菇，另秤熟白飯。

instructions.en: Arrange the warm beans and vegetables over the rice, keeping the soybean kernels and mushroom pieces intact.
instructions.zh: 將已溫熱豆與蔬菜放在飯上，保留完整黃豆粒與香菇塊。

instructions.en: Mix all measured olive oil and salt into the bowl, coating the beans and vegetables without adding an unlisted sauce.
instructions.zh: 將全部定量橄欖油與鹽均勻拌入豆與蔬菜，不另外添加未列出的醬汁。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Baked salmon, lentil and spinach bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤鮭魚扁豆菠菜碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses dry-heat-cooked farmed Atlantic salmon, whole boiled lentils, boiled spinach and leek bulb and lower leaves. All qualifying lentils and vegetables use cooked drained weights. This bowl has no separate grain or potato serving; its lentil and vegetable carbohydrates remain included in the nutrient totals. Assembly starts with prepared cooked ingredients.
notes.zh: 使用乾熱煮熟的養殖大西洋鮭魚、完整水煮扁豆、水煮菠菜及韭蔥莖基與下段葉。所有合格扁豆與蔬菜皆採熟後瀝乾重量。此碗未另加穀物或馬鈴薯，扁豆與蔬菜本身的碳水化合物仍計入營養總量；組裝從備妥熟食材起算。

instructions.en: Remove bones and inedible parts from the prepared baked salmon before weighing it. Weigh the whole cooked lentils.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟鮭魚先去骨及不可食部分再秤重，另秤完整熟扁豆。

instructions.en: Weigh boiled drained spinach and edible leek pieces. Arrange the warm lentils and vegetables in a bowl and place the salmon on top.
instructions.zh: 秤取水煮瀝乾菠菜與可食韭蔥段，把溫熱扁豆與蔬菜盛碗後放上鮭魚。

instructions.en: Add all measured olive oil and salt, keeping the lentils whole and serving the entire weighed portion.
instructions.zh: 加入全部定量橄欖油與鹽，保留完整扁豆粒，盛出整份秤好的食材。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Roasted turkey, sweet potato and red-pepper plate — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤火雞肉地瓜紅甜椒餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses roasted skinless turkey breast, baked sweet-potato flesh without skin, boiled red sweet pepper and onion. Weigh each in its source preparation state. Qualifying pepper and onion use cooked weights; sweet potato remains outside the model FVNS component while all its nutrients and mass are included.
notes.zh: 使用去皮烤火雞胸肉、去皮烤地瓜可食果肉、水煮紅甜椒及洋蔥，各自按來源製備狀態秤重。合格紅椒與洋蔥採熟重；地瓜不計入模型 FVNS 成分，但其全部營養與重量仍照常計入。

instructions.en: Remove skin and inedible parts from the prepared roast turkey before weighing. Remove sweet-potato skin and weigh only the baked edible flesh.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟火雞肉去皮及不可食部分後秤重；地瓜去皮，只秤烤熟可食果肉。

instructions.en: Weigh boiled drained red sweet pepper and onion. Arrange all prepared ingredients warm on a plate without additional frying.
instructions.zh: 秤取水煮瀝乾紅甜椒與洋蔥，將備妥食材溫熱盛盤，不另煎炒。

instructions.en: Distribute all measured olive oil and salt over the turkey and vegetables; serve the sweet potato alongside.
instructions.zh: 將全部定量橄欖油與鹽均勻拌入火雞肉與蔬菜，搭配地瓜一起食用。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Roasted lamb, lentil and carrot bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤羊腿肉扁豆胡蘿蔔碗（標準配方）

notes.en: The lamb source is roasted whole-leg separable lean meat, not ground lamb or fatty untrimmed slices. Whole boiled lentils, carrots and onion use cooked drained weights. There is no separate grain or potato serving; carbohydrates from lentils and vegetables are still counted. Assembly time excludes roasting the lamb or cooking dry lentils.
notes.zh: 羊肉來源為整支羊腿烤熟後可分離的瘦肉，不是羊絞肉或未去脂肪肉片。完整水煮扁豆、胡蘿蔔及洋蔥採熟後瀝乾重量。未另加穀物或馬鈴薯，扁豆與蔬菜的碳水化合物仍照常計入；組裝時間不含烤羊肉或烹煮乾扁豆。

instructions.en: Separate visible fat, bones and other inedible parts from the prepared roasted lamb leg, then weigh and slice only the edible lean meat.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟羊腿先分離可見脂肪、骨頭及其他不可食部分，再秤取可食瘦肉並切片。

instructions.en: Weigh whole cooked lentils and boiled drained carrot and onion pieces. Place them warm in a bowl with the lamb slices.
instructions.zh: 秤取完整熟扁豆與水煮瀝乾胡蘿蔔、洋蔥塊，溫熱後與羊肉片一起盛碗。

instructions.en: Mix in all measured olive oil and salt, keeping the lentils and vegetables in pieces.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部定量橄欖油與鹽，保留扁豆與蔬菜的粒塊狀態。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Pork, zucchini and cooked-tomato rice bowl — standard recipe
label.zh: 豬肉櫛瓜熟番茄飯碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses cooked crumbles made from 96% lean / 4% fat ground pork; that ratio describes the source starting meat, not the cooked fat percentage. Zucchini and tomato are cooked pieces, not a reduced or puréed sauce. Qualifying vegetables use cooked weights. Plain garlic powder contributes its archived total sugars as derived free sugars and no FVNS.
notes.zh: 使用以 96% 瘦肉／4% 脂肪豬絞肉製成的熟碎粒，該比例描述來源起始肉品，不是熟後脂肪百分比。櫛瓜與番茄保留熟塊，不收乾或打成醬泥；合格蔬菜採熟重。原味蒜粉的來源總糖推導為游離糖，粉末不計入 FVNS。

instructions.en: Weigh the prepared cooked pork crumbles and cooked white rice. Weigh boiled zucchini with skin and cooked tomato pieces in their listed states.
instructions.zh: 秤取備妥熟豬肉碎粒與熟白飯，另按表列狀態秤取帶皮水煮櫛瓜及熟番茄塊。

instructions.en: Arrange the warm rice, pork and vegetables in a bowl without reducing the tomato into a paste or adding cooking liquid.
instructions.zh: 將溫熱的飯、豬肉與蔬菜盛碗，不把番茄收乾成糊，也不額外加入烹調液。

instructions.en: Mix all measured plain garlic powder, olive oil and salt through the food, including every part of the seasoning.
instructions.zh: 將全部定量原味蒜粉、橄欖油與鹽拌入食材，完整使用整份調味料。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Baked cod, white bean and leek soup — standard recipe
label.zh: 烤鱈魚白菜豆韭蔥湯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses prepared dry-heat-cooked Atlantic cod, whole boiled white beans, boiled leek bulb and lower leaves, and celery. Cod is weighed after baking and before adding to the soup; no raw-fish yield is inferred. Qualifying beans and vegetables use cooked drained weights. The liquid is measured water with the listed oil and salt; no separate grain or potato is included.
notes.zh: 使用已乾熱煮熟的大西洋鱈魚、完整水煮白菜豆、水煮韭蔥莖基及下段葉與西洋芹。鱈魚先按烤熟狀態秤重再入湯，不推測生魚烹調得率；合格豆類與蔬菜採熟後瀝乾重量。湯液為定量水與表列油鹽，未另加穀物或馬鈴薯。

instructions.en: Remove bones and inedible parts from the prepared baked cod before weighing. Weigh whole cooked white beans and boiled drained leek and celery pieces.
instructions.zh: 已烤熟鱈魚先去骨及不可食部分再秤重，另秤完整熟白菜豆、水煮瀝乾韭蔥及西洋芹塊。

instructions.en: Warm the cod, beans and vegetables in the listed water. Before seasoning, restore evaporated water until the soup equals the combined selected weights of these solids and the listed water.
instructions.zh: 把鱈魚、豆及蔬菜加入表列水中溫熱，調味前補回蒸發水分，使湯總重等於這些固形食材所選重量與表列水量之和。

instructions.en: Stir in all measured olive oil and salt. Serve all liquid and solids together, keeping the beans whole.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部定量橄欖油與鹽，固形物與湯液全部一起盛出，保留完整豆粒。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Chickpea, quinoa and cauliflower bowl with sesame — standard recipe
label.zh: 鷹嘴豆藜麥白花椰菜芝麻碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses whole boiled chickpeas, cooked quinoa, boiled cauliflower and green peas, with toasted sesame kernels. Qualifying chickpeas, vegetables and sesame use cooked weights. The chickpeas and peas stay whole; the recipe does not use the separate puréed-chickpea calculation. Assembly starts with already cooked ingredients.
notes.zh: 使用完整水煮鷹嘴豆、熟藜麥、水煮白花椰菜與青豌豆，搭配烘烤芝麻仁。合格鷹嘴豆、蔬菜及芝麻皆採熟重；鷹嘴豆與豌豆保持完整，不套用獨立的鷹嘴豆泥計算法。組裝從已煮熟食材起算。

instructions.en: Weigh prepared whole boiled chickpeas and cooked quinoa. Weigh boiled drained cauliflower florets and whole green peas.
instructions.zh: 秤取備妥完整水煮鷹嘴豆與熟藜麥，另秤水煮瀝乾白花椰菜朵及完整青豌豆。

instructions.en: Arrange the warm quinoa, chickpeas, cauliflower and peas in a bowl without mashing or blending them.
instructions.zh: 將溫熱藜麥、鷹嘴豆、白花椰菜及青豌豆盛碗，不壓泥或攪打。

instructions.en: Add all measured olive oil and salt, then sprinkle the full weighed amount of toasted sesame kernels over the bowl.
instructions.zh: 加入全部定量橄欖油與鹽，再把全部秤好的烘烤芝麻仁撒在碗中。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Black bean, sweetcorn and red-pepper baked potato — standard recipe
label.zh: 黑菜豆玉米紅甜椒烤馬鈴薯（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses boiled black turtle beans (not black soybeans), sweetcorn kernels and red sweet pepper over baked potato with edible skin. Qualifying beans, corn and pepper use cooked weights; potato is excluded only from FVNS, with all its nutrients and mass retained. Whole beans and corn are not puréed.
notes.zh: 使用水煮黑菜豆（非黑大豆）、玉米粒與紅甜椒，搭配含可食外皮的烤馬鈴薯。合格豆類、玉米與紅椒採熟重；馬鈴薯僅不納入 FVNS，全部營養及重量仍保留。豆粒與玉米不打成泥。

instructions.en: Weigh prepared baked potato including edible skin, after removing any inedible parts. Split or cut the potato while keeping it in pieces.
instructions.zh: 備妥烤馬鈴薯去除不可食部分後，連可食外皮秤重，再切開或切塊，保留塊狀。

instructions.en: Weigh whole boiled black beans, boiled sweetcorn kernels and boiled drained red pepper. Add the warm ingredients on and beside the potato.
instructions.zh: 秤取完整水煮黑菜豆、水煮玉米粒與瀝乾水煮紅椒，把溫熱食材放在馬鈴薯上及旁邊。

instructions.en: Dress with all measured olive oil and salt and serve the complete portion without additional toppings.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部定量橄欖油與鹽，完整盛出，不另加配料。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Egg, edamame and bok choy rice noodles — standard recipe
label.zh: 雞蛋毛豆青江菜米麵（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses peeled hard-boiled egg, prepared shelled edamame, boiled bok choy and cooked rice noodles. Weigh shelled edamame kernels, not pods. Qualifying edamame and bok choy use cooked weights. The oil and salt listed are the complete added seasoning; this is an assembled noodle plate, not a stir-fry or broth estimate.
notes.zh: 使用去殼水煮全蛋、已製備去莢毛豆、水煮青江菜及熟米製麵條。毛豆秤可食豆仁，不含豆莢；合格毛豆與青江菜採熟重。表列油鹽為全部額外調味，此為組裝麵餐盤，不估算炒麵或高湯。

instructions.en: Peel and weigh the hard-boiled egg, then slice it. Weigh prepared shelled edamame and cooked drained rice noodles.
instructions.zh: 水煮蛋去殼秤重後切片，另秤已製備去莢毛豆與熟後瀝乾米製麵條。

instructions.en: Weigh boiled drained bok choy and arrange the warm noodles, edamame and vegetables on a plate, with egg slices on top.
instructions.zh: 秤取水煮瀝乾青江菜，把溫熱麵條、毛豆及蔬菜盛盤，再放上蛋片。

instructions.en: Toss with all measured olive oil and salt without adding unlisted sauce or extra frying oil.
instructions.zh: 拌入全部定量橄欖油與鹽，不另加未列出的醬汁或煎炒油。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Tuna, tomato and cucumber wholewheat sandwich — standard recipe
