label.zh: 鮪魚番茄小黃瓜全麥三明治（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses drained light tuna canned in water without added salt and the archived wholewheat French/Vienna-style bread. The tuna source still contains sodium, and the bread adds its own sodium; no salt or mayonnaise is added. Raw tomato and unpeeled cucumber are weighed as edible portions. Bread composition uncertainties remain visible in source notes and avoidance checks.
notes.zh: 使用未加鹽水浸淡色肉鮪魚罐頭的瀝乾固形物，以及歷史資料所指的全麥法式／維也納式麵包。鮪魚來源仍含鈉，麵包也有本身的鈉；配方不另加鹽或美乃滋。生番茄及帶皮小黃瓜按可食部分秤重，麵包配方不確定性仍保留於來源備註與避食檢查。

instructions.en: Drain the canned tuna and weigh only the solids. Weigh the bread as supplied, without toasting it.
instructions.zh: 鮪魚罐頭瀝乾後只秤固形物，麵包依原樣秤重，不另烘烤。

instructions.en: Wash and trim the tomato and unpeeled cucumber, weigh them raw, then slice. Place the tuna and vegetables on the bread; serve any excess vegetables alongside.
instructions.zh: 清洗修整番茄與帶皮小黃瓜，採生重秤好再切片，與鮪魚夾入麵包；放不下的蔬菜另盛搭配。

instructions.en: Drizzle all measured olive oil over the filling and side vegetables. Keep chilled until serving, with no extra salt or spread.
instructions.zh: 將全部定量橄欖油淋在內餡與配菜上，食用前保持冷藏，不另加鹽或抹醬。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Mozzarella, avocado and tomato bread plate — standard recipe
label.zh: 莫札瑞拉酪梨番茄麵包餐盤（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses plain whole-milk mozzarella, raw avocado flesh, raw tomato and the archived wholewheat French/Vienna-style bread. Qualifying avocado and tomato use raw edible weights; avocado peel and stone are excluded before weighing. The bread keeps its documented ingredient uncertainty. The cheese and bread sodium are counted even though no salt is added.
notes.zh: 使用原味全脂莫札瑞拉起司、生酪梨果肉、生番茄及歷史資料所指的全麥法式／維也納式麵包。合格酪梨與番茄採可食生重，酪梨先去皮去籽再秤；麵包保留已記錄的成分不確定性。雖不另加鹽，起司與麵包本身的鈉仍計入。

instructions.en: Weigh the plain whole-milk mozzarella and bread as supplied. Slice the cheese without melting or adding toppings.
instructions.zh: 原味全脂莫札瑞拉起司與麵包依原樣秤重，起司切片，不另融化或加配料。

instructions.en: Remove avocado peel and stone before weighing the raw flesh. Wash, trim and weigh the tomato raw, then slice both onto the plate.
instructions.zh: 酪梨去皮去籽後秤生果肉；番茄清洗修整後採生重秤好，再將兩者切片盛盤。

instructions.en: Arrange the cheese and bread with the fruit and vegetable slices. Add all measured olive oil and keep chilled until serving, without extra salt or dressing.
instructions.zh: 把起司、麵包與蔬果片一起擺盤，加入全部定量橄欖油，食用前保持冷藏，不另加鹽或沙拉醬。

instructions.en: Use the selected-portion list for every ingredient amount, including any listed seasonings and liquids.
instructions.zh: 每項食材均採所選份量清單的克數，所有表列調味料與液體也一併調整。

label.en: Cottage cheese, banana and oatmeal bowl with honey — standard recipe
label.zh: 茅屋起司香蕉燕麥蜂蜜碗（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses plain 2% milkfat cottage cheese, oats already cooked with water without salt, raw peeled banana and measured honey. The oat amount is final cooked oatmeal weight, not dry oats or extra water. Banana remains in slices and uses raw edible weight. All sugars in the listed honey are counted as free sugars; the dairy and oat source values remain separate.
notes.zh: 使用原味乳脂 2% 茅屋起司、已用水無鹽煮熟的燕麥、去皮生香蕉與定量蜂蜜。燕麥克數是最終煮熟燕麥粥重量，不是乾燕麥或額外水量。香蕉保留切片並採可食生重；表列蜂蜜的全部糖計為游離糖，乳品與燕麥仍各採本身來源值。

instructions.en: Weigh prepared chilled oatmeal that was cooked with water and no salt. Weigh the plain 2% cottage cheese separately.
instructions.zh: 秤取已用水無鹽煮熟並冷藏的燕麥粥，另秤原味乳脂 2% 茅屋起司。

instructions.en: Peel the banana before weighing its raw edible flesh, then slice it. Place the banana and cottage cheese over the oatmeal without blending.
instructions.zh: 香蕉先去皮再秤可食生果肉，切片後與茅屋起司一起放在燕麥粥上，不攪打成泥。

instructions.en: Drizzle the full weighed amount of honey over the bowl. Keep chilled until serving; add no unlisted milk, sugar or liquid.
instructions.zh: 將全部秤好的蜂蜜淋在碗上，食用前保持冷藏，不另加未列出的牛奶、糖或液體。

label.en: Parmesan, lentil and spinach wholewheat pasta — standard recipe
label.zh: 帕瑪森扁豆菠菜全麥義大利麵（標準配方）

notes.en: Uses whole boiled lentils, cooked wholewheat pasta, boiled spinach and plain hard Parmesan cheese. Qualifying lentils and spinach use cooked drained weights. Parmesan is weighed from the hard cheese before grating; no unspecified cheese sauce or cream is included. Natural dairy sugars retain their documented model treatment, and the cheese sodium is included.
notes.zh: 使用完整水煮扁豆、熟全麥義大利麵、水煮菠菜及原味硬質帕瑪森起司。合格扁豆與菠菜採熟後瀝乾重量；帕瑪森先按硬質起司秤好再刨碎，不加入成分不明的起司醬或鮮奶油。天然乳糖保留已記錄的模型處理，起司本身的鈉也完整計入。

instructions.en: Weigh prepared cooked drained wholewheat pasta, whole lentils and boiled spinach. Keep the lentils intact.
instructions.zh: 秤取備妥熟後瀝乾的全麥義大利麵、完整扁豆及水煮菠菜，保留完整豆粒。

instructions.en: Combine the warm pasta, lentils and spinach with all measured olive oil and salt. Do not add unlisted pasta water or cream.
instructions.zh: 將溫熱麵、扁豆及菠菜與全部定量橄欖油、鹽拌勻，不另加未列出的煮麵水或鮮奶油。

instructions.en: Weigh the plain hard Parmesan, grate it and add the entire amount to the pasta before serving.
instructions.zh: 原味硬質帕瑪森秤重後刨碎，將整份起司加入麵中再食用。
